tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// kyai rdo rje lha dgu'i mngon rtogs dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga dang bcas pa dngos grub kyi gter mdzod ces bya ba khrigs chags bklag chog tu bkod pa bzhugs so//

༄༅// "$ bla ma dang bcom ldan 'das dpal dgyes pa la rdo rje phyag 'tshal lo// dgyes pa rnams kyi bde ba rnal 'byor ma yi pad+ma'i dbus na gnas gyur pa// rdo rje gar gyis rol bas rjes bsgrubs thar pa'i mtshan nyid rnam par ston pa'i sku// zhal brgyad zhabs bzhi bcu drug phyag dang gar dgu'i nyams ldan in+d+ra nī la nyid// bcag pa'i 'phro ltar sngo ba'i 'od 'dzin bdag med lha mos 'khyud la phyag 'tshal lo// de yang*/ dgyes pa rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur ba thob cing dam tshig dang ldan pa'i rnal 'byor pas/ thang sku mtshan nyid dang ldan pa bris/ de la rab tu gnas pa tshul bzhin du byas la/ bdud rtsi ril bu la sogs pa'i mchod pa'i yo byad tshogs pas/ dur khrod dam/ chu 'gram mam/ nags tshal la sogs pa skye bos dben pa'i gnas su sgrub pa pos phyin la/ der maṇ+ḍal dang mchod pa dang gtor ma bshams nas gnas nye bar brgyan te/ stan bde ba la skyil mo krung gis 'dug ste mngon par rtogs pa bsgom pa la/ lus kyi zhen pa zlog pa'i don du bskyed pa'i rim pa bsgom pa dang*/ ngag gi zhen pa zlog pa'i don du bzlas pa bya ba dang*/ sems kyi zhen pa zlog pa'i don du rdzogs pa'i rim pa bsgom pa dang*/ thun mtshams kyi chos so// dang po la/ rgyu'i he ru ka bskyed pa dang*/ 'bras bu'i he ru ka bskyed pa gnyis las/ dang po la chos bcu las/ bla ma dag pa'i cho ga ni/ tho rangs langs nas khrus kyi rnal 'byor byas te/ 'og nas 'byung ba bzhin in+d+ra'i gtor ma gtang*/ dril bu gsil zhing / oṃ rak+ṣa rak+ṣa hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ swā hā/ zhes pas gnas dang bdag dang rnal 'byor bsrung*/ de nas/ he badz+ra/ rang nyid skad cig gis dgyes pa rdo rje sku mdog nag po zhal brgyad zhabs bzhi phyag bcu drug pa yum bdag med ma dang zhal sbyar ba'i skur gyur/ hrīḥlas snying pad+ma dmar po 'dab ma brgyad pa kha bye ba'i dbus su raṃ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor dmar po/

de'i dbus su hūm̐ sngon po 'od zer lnga dang bcas pa/ hūm̐ gi 'od zer gyis bcom ldan 'das 'khor gyi lha mo mchod pa byed bzhin pa dang bcas pa/ shar khyams na rang gi bla ma bzhugs pa mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs/ oṃ gau rī gaṃ āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ rang gi snying ka'i hūm̐ las byung ba'i gau ri ma nag mos bdud rtsi byang chub sems kyis thod pa bkang nas mchod par bsam/ de zin pa'i brdar se gol gcig gtog oṃ tsau rī tsaṃ āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ tsau ri ma dmar mos pad+ma rak+tas thod pa bkang nas mchod par bsam/ oṃ bai tā lī baṃ āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ bai tā li ser mos bdud rtsi dri chus thod pa bkang nas mchod par bsam/ oṃ ghasma rī ghaṃ āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ ghasma rī ljang khus bdud rtsi dri chen gyis thod pa bkang nas mchod par bsam/ oṃ puk+ka sī paṃ āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ puk+ka si sngon mos sha sna tshogs kyis thod pa bkang nas mchod par bsam/ oṃ sha wa ri' shaṃ āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ sha wa rī dkar mos bdud rtsi sbrang chang gis thod pa bkang nas mchod par bsam/ oṃ tsaṇ+ḍa lī tsaṃ āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ tsaṇ+ḍa li sngon mos cang te'u'i sgras mchod par bsam/ oṃ ḍom+bi nī ḍaṃ āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ ḍom+bi ni khra mos snyoms 'jug gis mchod par bsam mo// lan lag lhag ma drug yid kyis bsgom zhing*/ dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su mchi// sdig pa thams cad so sor bshags// 'gro ba'i dge la rjes yi rang*// sangs rgyas byang chub yid kyis gzung*// sangs rgyas chos dang tshogs mchog la// byang chub bar du skyabs su mchi// byang chub sems su 'di bgyis te// bdag dang gzhan don rab bsgrub phyir// bdag gis byang chub sems mchog bskyed// e ma ho sems can kun mgron gnyer// byang chub spyod mchog mdzad bzhin spyad// 'gro la phan phyir sangs rgyas shog/ ces lan gsum/ he badz+ra man+ḍal muḥtshogs gsog pa'i rten rang bzhin gyi gnas su gshegs par gyur/

gnyis pa tshad med bzhi bsgom pa ni/ sems can thams cad bde ba dang phrad na ci ma rung snyam pa'i byams pa dang*/ sems can sdug bsngal dang bral na ci ma rung snyam pa'i snying rje dang*/ bde ba de yang rgyun brtan na ci ma rung snyam pa'i dga' ba dang*/ dgra med gnyen med bshes med zun med pa'i btang snyoms la gnas par bya'o// gsum pa stong pa nyid bsgom pa ni/ de nas/ snying ga'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas snod kyi 'jig rten bcud la bsdu/ de rang gi lus la bsdu// de yas 'dus mas 'dus pa las snying pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa la thim/ de nyi ma la thim// de hūm̐ gi zhabs kyu la/ de ha la/ de zla tshes la/ de thig le la thim pas nā da'i rnam pa lta bur gyur/ oṃ shū n+ya tā dzñā na badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ nā da las rang sgra byung bar bsam mo// bzhi pa bsrung ba'i 'khor lo ni/ de nas/ rang gi sems nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor de nyid kyi steng du/ hūm̐ las sna tshogs rdo rje/ de'i lte ba la hūm̐/ de las 'od zer rtse mo la rdo rje rgya gram pa dpag tu med pa 'phros pas/ 'og tu song bas rdo rje'i sa gzhi/ bar snang du song bas rdo rje'i rwa ba dang drwa ba/ steng du song bas rdo rje'i gur/ gzhi mo'i nyi ma las me'i 'od zer phyir 'phros pas me ri/ gzhi me'i rdo rje rgya gram pa las rdo rje rkyang pa dpag tu med pa 'phros pas rdo rje'i drwa mig rnams bkag par gyur/ oṃ rak+ṣa rak+ṣa hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ swā hā/ zhes brjod pas brtan par mos/ lnga pa chos 'byung ni/ de'i nang du chos kyi 'byung gnas gru gsum pa rtsa ba phra ba thur du zug pa/ gdengs ka che ba/ kha dog dkar po/ drug pa 'byung ba rim brtsegs ni/ de'i nang du sa'i dkyil 'khor gru bzhi/ de'i steng du chu'i dkyil 'khor zlum po/ de'i steng du me'i dkyil 'khor gru gsum/ de'i steng du rlung gi dkyil 'khor zla gam/

bdun pa gzhal yas khang gdan dang bcas pa ni/ 'byung bzhi'i steng du bh+rūṃ las 'khor lo rtsibs sum cu rtsa gnyis pa/ 'khor lo de'i dbus su nā da cha gcig zhugs/ de rnams 'dres pa las rin po che sna lnga las grub pa'i gzhal yas khang mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa gru bzhi sgo bzhi rta babs bzhi dang ldan pa/ rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ shar dkar/ lho ser/ nub dmar/ byang ljang ba/ dbus su pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa lte ba nag po/ ze'u 'bru khra bo/ 'dab brgyad dmar po/ gong ras nag po/ thod 'phreng dkar po/ phyi rol tu dur khrod chen po brgyad kyis bskor ba bsgoms la/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a nī la badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ de'i dbus su nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du tshangs pa ser po dang dbang po dkar po gnyis mgo g.yas su blta ba/ nye dbang nag po dang drag po sngon po gnyis mgo g.yon du blta ba/ 'dab ma brgyad la shar nas phyogs dang byang shar nas mtshams g.yas skor du tshangs pa/ dbang po/ nye dbang*/ drag po/ gshin rje nag po/ nor bdag ser po/ srin po sngo nag thags bzang ris ljang khu rnams mgo g.yon du blta ba/ gan rkyal du bsgyel ba/ kun gzhi dang ldan pa/ rnam par snang mdzad kyi yan lag go /brgyad pa mngon par byang chub pa lngas rgyu'i he ru ka bskyed pa ni/ dbus kyi bdud bzhi'i steng du/ a ā/ i ī/ u ū/ ṛ ṝ/ l̥ l̥̄/ e ai/ o au/ aṃ aḥtshar gcig brjod pas/ ā li g.yas skor gcig dang g.yon skor gcig las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor/ de mngon par byang chub pa na dang po/ ye shes na me long lta bu'i ye shes/ ka kha ga gha nga*/ tsa tsha dza dzha nya/ ṭa ṭha ḍa ḍha ṇa/ ta tha da dha na/ pa pha ba bha ma/ ya ra la wa/ sha ṣa sa ha k+ṣaḥtshar gcig brjod pas de'i steng du kā li g.yas skor gcig dang g.yon skor gcig las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor du gyur/ de mngon par byang chub pa na gnyis pa/ ye shes na/

mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes/ de gnyis kyi dbus su hūm̐ dang a de las rdo rje hūm̐ gis mtshan pa dang*/ gri gug as mtshan pa/ de byang chub pa na gsum pa/ ye shes na/ so sor kun tu rtog pa'i ye shes/ de las 'od zer 'phros/ 'dus pas nyi ma zla ba sa bon phyag mtshan rnams krug gis 'dres pa/ de byang chub pa na bzhi pa/ ye shes na/ bya ba nan tan gyi ye shes 'phro 'dus pa las rang nyid rgyu'i he ru ka bcom ldan 'das dpal dgyes pa rdo rje sku mdog nag po zhal brgyad zhabs bzhi phyag bcu drug pa/ rtsa ba'i zhal nag pa/ g.yas zhal dkar ba/ g.yon zhal dmar ba cher 'jigs pa/ lhag ma'i zhal gnyis gnyis nag pa/ steng zhal dud kha gtsigs pa/ zhal re re la spyan gsum gsum dang ldan zhing spyan rtsa dmar ba dbu skra ser po gyen du brdzes pa/ spyi bor sna tshogs rdo rjes mtshan pa/ phyag g.yas pa'i thod pa brgyad kyi dang po na glang po che dkar po/ gnyis pa na rta sngon po/ gsum pa na bong bu gwa pa/ bzhi pa na glang dmar po/ lnga pa na rnga mo thal kha/ drug pa na mi dmar po/ bdun pa na seng ge sngon po/ brgyad pa na byi la gwa pa rnams gdong nang du bstan te bsnams pa/ g.yon pa'i thod pa brgyad kyi dang po na sa'i lha mo ser mo/ gnyis pa na chu'i lha mo dkar mo/ gsum pa na rlung gi lha mo dud kha/ bzhi pa na me'i lha mo dmar mo/ lnga pa na zla ba'i lha mo dkar mo/ drug pa na nyi ma'i lha mo dmar mo/ bdun pa na gshin rje nag po/ brgyad pa na nor bdag ser po/ de thams cad kyang zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa thal mo snying kar sbyar ba zhal phyir bstan te bsnams pa/ phyag dang po gnyis kyis yum la 'khyud pa/ dbu re re la mi mgo skam po lnga lngas brgyan cing*/ rlon pa khrag 'dzag pa lnga bcu'i phreng bas do shal byas pa/ thal chen gyis lus la byugs pa/ gar gyi nyams dgu dang ldan pa/ zhabs bzhi'i g.yas pa gnyis brkyang zhing g.yon pa gnyis bskum pa'i gar stabs kyis bdud bzhi'i snying ga mnan pa/

de'i yum bdag med ma sku mdog nag mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma/ spyan gsum dmar ba/ dbu skra ser po gyen du brdzes pa g.yas gri gug g.yon thod pa khrag gis gang ba bsnams nas yab kyi mgul nas 'khyud pa/ mi mgo skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan dang*/ rlon pa lnga bcu'i 'phreng bas do shal byas pa/ zhabs g.yas pa yab la 'khyud cing g.yon brkyang ba/ yab yum gnyis ka'i spyi bor rus pa'i 'khor lo/ rna rgyan mgul rgyan lag gdub ska rags te rus pa'i rgyan cha lngas brgyan pa/ mtshan dang dpe byad kyis spras pa/ me ri me dpung gi nang na bzhugs par gyur/ de byang chub pa na lnga pa/ ye shes na/ chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes so// dgu pa rdo rje dang pad+ma byin gyis brlabs nas snyoms 'jug bya ba ni/ yum gyi gsang gnas stong pa hrīḥpad+ma as ze'u 'bru/ phaṭ ser po zhig gis bug pa bkag pa yab kyis bskul ba/ oṃ pad+ma su kha dhā ra ma hā rā ga su khaṃ tsa tu rā ga si na hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ kar+yaṃ ku ru ṣ+wa me/ yab kyi gsang gnas stong pa hūm̐ las rdo rje oṃ gyis nor bu byas pa phaṭ kyis bu ga bkag pa yum gyis bskul/ oṃ badz+ra mahā dwe ṣa tsa tur ā nan+dā ya kā ka mu khe ka rā so nā tha hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ kar+yaṃ ku ru ṣ+wa me/ yab yum gnyis snyoms par zhugs pa'i sbyor mtshams nas 'od zer spros te/ sangs rgyas kyi thugs gnyis su med pa'i bcud tshur bsdus te yab kyi zhal du zhugs/ a ba dhu tī nas rdo rje nor bur byang chub sems kyi ngo bo gaṃ tsaṃ baṃ ghaṃ paṃ shaṃ tsaṃ ḍaṃ pad+mar spros/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a nu rā ga ṇa badz+ri swa bhā wa at+ma ko3haṃ/ rdo rje sems dpa'i yan lag go /bcu pa 'khor gyi lha mo brgyad bskyed pa ni/ so so'i sa bon las lha mor gyur te/ pad+ma nas rim pa bzhin 'thon par bsam/ oṃ gau rī gaṃ swā hā/ shar du gau rī ma nag mo g.yas gri gug g.yon ro hi ta'i nya bsnams pa/

oṃ tsau ri tsaṃ swā hā/ lhor tsaṃ ri ma dmar mo g.yas cang te'u g.yon phag pa bsnams pa/ oṃ bai ta lī baṃ swā hā/ nub tu bai tā li ser mo g.yas ru sbal/ g.yon thod pa bsnams pa/ oṃ ghasma rī ghaṃ swā hā/ byang du ghasma rī ljang khu g.yas sbrul/ g.yon rnal 'byor gyi lhung bzed bsnams pa/ oṃ puska sī paṃ swā hā/ puska sī sngon mo g.yas seng ge/ g.yon dgra s+t+wa bsnams pa/ oṃ sha wa ri shaṃ swā hā/ sha ba ri dkar mo g.yas dge slong*/ g.yon gsil byed bsnams pa/ oṃ tsaṇ+ḍā li tsaṃ swā hā/ tsaṇ+ḍa li sngon mo g.yas 'khor lo/ g.yon thod pa bsnams pa/ oṃ ḍom+bi nī ḍāṃ swā hā/ ḍom+bi nī zhal ras dkar ba/ thugs ka nag pa/ lte ba dmar ba/ mdongs mo dkar ba/ brla dang dpung pa ser ba/ lag ngar gnyis dang rkang pa'i rje ngar ljang khu/ g.yas rdo rje/ g.yon sdigs mdzub mdzad pa/ lha mo de thams cad zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma/ spyan gsum dmar ba/ dbu skra ser po gyen du brdzes pa/ rus pa'i rgyan cha lngas brgyan pa/ zhabs g.yon brkyang ba/ g.yas pa'i mthil g.yon pa'i brla la gtad de skyil krung phyed pa'i gar stabs kyis me ri dang me dpung gi nang na bzhugs par gyur/ gnyis pa 'bras bu'i he ru ka bskyed pa la bcu las/ dang po dri za nye bar zhugs pa ni/ de nas nam mkha'i nā da de skar mda' 'pho ba bzhin du bcom ldan 'das kyi zhal du zhugs nas yum gyi pad+mar phab pas yum bde ba'i ngo bor zhu/ yum zhu bas yab kyang bde ba'i ror zhu nas dngul chu'i rnam pa lta bur gyur/ gnyis pa mtshams kyi lha mo bzhis glus bskul ba ni/ de nas mtshams kyi lha mo bzhis gtso bo yab yum med par shes nas mya ngan gyi glus bskul ba ni/ rje btsun snying rje'i yid bzhengs shig /puk+ka sī ni bdag la skyobs// stong pa'i rang bzhin nyid spongs la// bdag la bde chen sbyor bzhed mdzod// khyod med na ni bdag 'gum pas// kye yi rdo rje khyod bzhengs shig

/stong pa'i rang bzhin nyid spongs la// ri khrod ma 'bras grub par mdzod// dga' gtso 'jig rten mgron gnyer ba// stong pa nyid la zhugs sam ci// khyod med phyogs ni mi 'tshal bas// gdol pa mo bdag zhu ba bgyid// bdag gis khyod kyi thugs 'tshal gyi// mig 'phrul mnga' ba khyod bzhengs shig /g.yung mo bdag ni dran nyams pas// snying rje'i rgyun chad ma mdzad cig /ces shin tu snyan pa'i glus bskul bas/ gsum pa cho ga gsum gyis 'bras bu'i he ru kar bzhengs pa ni/ sngon gyi smon lam rjes su dran nas dngul chu'i rnam pa lta bu las 'od zer 'phros/ sangs rgyas mchod/ sems can gyi don byas nas tshur 'dus pa las a dang hūm̐ du gyur/ de nas 'od 'phros sangs rgyas mchod/ sems can gyi don byas nas tshur 'dus pa las rdo rje sngon po lte ba hūm̐ gis mtshan pa dang*/ gri gug yu ba as mtshan par gyur/ phyag mtshan sa bon gyis mtshan pa las dgyes pa rdo rje'i sku phra mo dpag tu med pa 'phros/ sangs rgyas mchod/ sems can gyi don byas/ tshur 'dus sa bon phyag mtshan sku phra mo rnams gcig tu 'dres pa las rang nyid 'bras bu'i he ru ka bcom ldan 'das dpal dgyes pa rdo rje sku mdog nag po zhal brgyad zhabs bzhi phyag bcu drug pa rtsa ba'i zhal nag pa/ g.yas zhal dkar ba/ g.yon zhal dmar ba cher 'jigs pa/ lhag ma'i zhal gnyis gnyis nag pa/ steng zhal dud kha gtsigs pa/ zhal re re la spyan gsum gsum dang ldan zhing spyan rtsa dmar ba dbu skra ser po gyen du brdzes pa/ spyi bor sna tshogs rdo rjes mtshan pa/ phyag g.yas pa'i thod pa brgyad kyi dang po na glang po che dkar po/ gnyis pa na rta sngon po/ gsum pa na bong bu gwa pa/ bzhi pa na glang dmar po/ lnga pa na rnga mo thal kha/ drug pa na mi dmar po/ bdun pa na seng ge sngon po/ brgyad pa na byi la gwa pa rnams gdong nang du bstan te bsnams pa/ g.yon pa'i thod pa brgyad kyi dang po na sa'i lha mo ser mo/

gnyis pa na chu'i lha mo dkar mo/ gsum pa na rlung gi lha mo dud kha/ bzhi pa na me'i lha mo dmar mo/ lnga pa na zla ba'i lha mo dkar mo/ drug pa na nyi ma'i lha mo dmar mo/ bdun pa na gshin rje nag po/ brgyad pa na nor bdag ser po/ de thams cad kyang zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa thal mo snying kar sbyar ba zhal phyir bstan te bsnams pa/ phyag dang po gnyis kyis yum la 'khyud pa/ dbu re re la mi mgo skam po lnga lngas brgyan cing*/ rlon pa khrag 'dzag pa lnga bcu'i phreng bas do shal byas pa/ thal chen gyis lus la byugs pa/ gar gyi nyams dgu dang ldan pa/ zhabs bzhi'i g.yas pa gnyis brkyang zhing g.yon pa gnyis bskum pa'i gar stabs kyis bdud bzhi'i snying ga mnan pa/ de'i yum bdag med ma sku mdog nag mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma/ spyan gsum dmar ba/ dbu skra ser po gyen du brdzes pa g.yas gri gug /g.yon thod pa khrag gis gang ba bsnams nas yab kyi mgul nas 'khyud pa/ mi mgo skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan dang*/ rlon pa lnga bcu'i 'phreng bas do shal byas pa/ zhabs g.yas pa yab la 'khyud cing g.yon brkyang ba/ yab yum gnyis ka'i spyi bor rus pa'i 'khor lo/ rna rgyan mgul rgyan lag gdub ska rags te rus pa'i rgyan cha lngas brgyan pa/ mtshan dang dpe byad kyis spras pa/ me ri dang me dpung gi nang du bzhugs par gyur/

zhes pa'i bar rnams gong ji ltar bzhin du bsgom mo// bcom ldan 'das kyi thugs kar ye shes sems dpa' rang 'dra ba tshon gang ba/ de'i thugs kar ting nge 'dzin sems dpa' rdo rje sngon po rtse dgu pa nas tsam pa'i lte ba la sran chung gshags pa'i ga'u tsam pa'i nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor/ de'i dbus su hūm̐ sngon po spus bris pa tsam pa/ yum gyi thugs kar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du a sngon po 'od zer dang bcas pa/ bzhi pa skye mched drug dang sku gsung thugs byin gyis brlab pa ni/ gtso bo'i mig tu oṃ las gti mug rdo rje ma dkar mo/ rna bar haṃ las zhe sdang rdo rje ma nag mo/ sna la maṃ las ser sna rdo rje ma ser mo/ lce la raṃ las 'dod chags rdo rje ma dmar mo/ dpral bar aṃ las phrag dog rdo rje ma ljang khu/ snying gi cha stod du a las dbang phyug rdo rje ma sngon mo/ spyi bor oṃ las sku rdo rje ma dkar mo/ mgrin par āḥlas gsung rdo rje ma dmar mo/ snying gi cha smad du hūm̐ las thugs rdo rje ma sngon mo/ de thams cad kyang zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ g.yas na gri gug /g.yon thod pa/ mchan khung du kha ṭ+wāṃ ga bcug pa/ skyil krung phyed pa'i gar gyis ro'i gdan gyi steng na bzhugs pa'o// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta khe tsa ri badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta bhū tsa rī badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta pa tā la wā si nī badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ lnga pa ye shes sems dpa' spyan drangs nas gnyis su med par bsre ba ni/ rang gi snying ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas ye shes kyi dgyes pa rdo rje lha dgu'i dkyil 'khor mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs/ rdo rje bsang gtor gyi chu'i nang du bcug la des mchod rdzas la gtor zhing*/ hūm̐ zhes brjod pas mchod rdzas kyi bgegs bskrad/ de nas lag pa rdo rje dang ldan pas mchod rdzas la bskor zhing*/

oṃ āḥham̐'u lan gsum gyis mchod rdzas thams cad bde stong du byin gyis brlabs/ de nas lag pa g.yon pas dril bu dkrol zhing g.yas pas mchod rdzas gang yin de blangs la btab pa'i tshul gyis 'bul/ oṃ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥkhaṃ raṃ āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ mchod yon/ oṃ ni ri ti hūm̐ khaṃ āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ zhabs bsil/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ oṃ badz+ra dhū pe āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ de bzhin du dhū pe'i gnas su/ gan+dhe= nai wi d+ya= ā lo ke= lngas mchod/ oṃ gau rī gaṃ āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ thog mtha' 'dra bas/ oṃ tsau rī tsaṃ= oṃ bai tā lī baṃ= oṃ ghasma rī ghaṃ= oṃ puk+ka sī paṃ= oṃ sha wa rī shaṃ= oṃ tsaṇ+ḍa lī tsaṃ= oṃ ḍom+bi nī ḍāṃ= zhes lha mo brgyad kyi sngags 'ba' zhig gis mchod/ rdo rje dril bu gzung la/ zhe sdang rdo rjer phyag 'tshal bstod// gti mug rdo rjer phyag 'tshal bstod// ser sna rdo rjes bdag la skyobs// 'dod chags rdo rje bdag la stsol// phrag dog rdo rje nga rgyal te// sgyu 'phrul rdo rje mgon po kun// las kun rab tu sgrub byed pa// thams cad rdo rje'i bdag mgur 'gyur/ gau rī dzaḥdam tshig sems dpa'i mgo thog tu ye shes sems dpa' dgug /tsau rī hūm̐/ gzhug /bai tā lī baṃ/ bcing*/ ghasma rī hoḥmi dgyes pa med par dgyes par gyur/ drug pa dbang bskur ba ni/ de nas/ rang gi snying ka'i hūm̐ sa bon las 'od zer nag po lcags kyu'i rnam pa'i tshul gyis phyung nas des khams gsum du bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas thams cad spyan drangs la/ oṃ gau rī gaṃ āḥhūm̐ sogs lha mo brgyad kyi sngags gong ltar gyis mchod/ oṃ a bhiṣiñtsa tu māṃ sarba ta thā ga ta/ zhes gsol ba btab pas sangs rgyas de rnams he ru ka'i rnam pa'i gzugs kyis de bzhin gshegs pa lnga'i bdag nyid kyi bdud rtsi lngas gang ba'i bum pas dbang bskur/ dbang bskur ba na me tog gi char 'bab par 'gyur ro// rnga'i sgra 'byung bar 'gyur ro// gzugs rdo rje ma la sogs pa rnams kyis mchod par bya'o// rdo rje'i glu spyan ma la sogs pa rnams kyis blangs bar bya'o// dbang bskur nas chu cung zad yar 'khyil ba las gtso bo yab yum/

puk+ka sī dang gau ri ma la mi bskyod pa/ sha wa rī dang tsau rī ma la rnam par snang mdzad/ tsaṇ+ḍa lī dang bai tā lī la rin chen 'byung ldan/ ḍom+bi nī dang ghasma rī la snang ba mtha' yas kyis dbu brgyan par gyur/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ mi bskyod pa'i yan lag go// bdun pa bdud rtsi myang ba ni/ de nas/ 'og tu yaṃ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor dud kha gzhu'i dbyibs lta bu tha ma gnyis ba dan gyis mtshan pa/ de'i steng du raṃ las me'i dkyil 'khor dmar po gru gsum pa/ de'i steng du a las thod pa phyi dkar la nang dmar ba/ nang gi dbus su mi'i sha dang byang chub kyis sems/ shar du glang po che'i sha dang dri chen/ lhor rta'i sha dang dri chu/ nub tu ba lang gi sha dang rak+ta/ byang du khyi'i sha dang brgyungs pa/ de rnams kyi phyi'i rnam pa oṃ/ srog āḥde'i steng du zla phyed rdo rje'i rtse mo la hūm̐ gis mtshan pa/ mgo thur du blta ba/ rlung gis me sbar thod pa bsros/ sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga khol bas/ oṃ dang āḥlas 'od zer spros te zla phyed rdo rje hūm̐ dang bcas pa las ye shes kyi bdud rtsi phab/ dam tshig gi bdud rtsi dang gnyis su med par 'dres par gyur/ oṃ āḥham̐'u lan gsum brjod/ mthar zla phyed rdo rje yang thod pa'i nang du lhung ste zhu bas bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin du gyur/ gtso 'khor thams cad kyi ljags kyi rtse mo las rdo rje nas 'bru tsam pa/ de'i 'od zer gyi sbu gus bdud rtsi drangs nas gsol bas shin tu mnyes par gyur/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a mṛ tā swa da badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma konyahaṃ/ 'od dpag med kyi yan lag go /brgyad pa mchod pa ni/ de nas lha dgu'i thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas 'jig rten gyi khams na gzugs sdug pa/ sgra snyan pa/ dri zhim pa/ ro mngar ba/ reg bya 'jam pa rnams 'od zer gyis bsdus nas lha snam gyi steng du mchod pa'i lha mo dpag tu med par spros pas/

de rnams kyis lha dgu'i dkyil 'khor la mchod pa byed par gyur/ bcom ldan deng 'dir byon pa legs// bdag cag bsod nams skal par ldan// bdag las mchod yon bzhes nas kyang*// thugs rjes thugs dpag mdzad du gsol// oṃ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥkhaṃ raṃ āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyis ni// lha rnams kyis ni khrus gsol ltar// lha yi chu ni dag pa yi// de bzhin bdag gis sku khrus gsol// oṃ nī ri ti hūm̐ khaṃ āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ me tog bzang po mdzes shing gtsang*// gtsang ma'i gnas skyes 'di rnams ni// bdag ni gus pas 'bul lags kyis// so sor bzhes te dgyes par mdzod/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūm̐ swā hā// yid dga' snying po ro mchog ldan// bdug pa bla re'i dri mchog ni// bdag= so sor= dhū pe= gtsang zhing bzang la dge ba'i dri// skyes gnas gtsang mar ldan 'di rnams// bdag= so sor= gan+dhe= gtsang zhing gtsang la dge ba'i bshos// skyes gnas gtsang mar ldan 'di rnams/ bdag= so sor= nai wi d+yaṃ= dmar gsal sdug pa dag cing gtsang*// dge zhing mun sel mar me 'di// bdag ni= so sor= ā lo ke= de las gzhan yang mchod pa'i tshogs// rol mo sgra snyan yid 'ong ldan// bdag= so sor= oṃ badz+ra shap+ta āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ oṃ gau rī gaṃ āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ thog mtha' 'dra bas/ oṃ tsau rī tsaṃ= oṃ bai tā lī baṃ= oṃ ghasma rī ghaṃ= oṃ puk+ka sī paṃ= oṃ sha wa ri' shaṃ= oṃ tsaṇ+ḍā lī tsaṃ= oṃ ḍom+bi nī ḍāṃ= ces mchod/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta pū dza badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ don yod grub pa'i yan lag go /dgu pa bstod pa ni/ oṃ mahā badz+ra hūm̐ zhes pas rdo rje gzung*/ oṃ badz+ra ghaṇ+ḍe ā zhes pas dril bu gzung ste/ mchod pa'i lha mo de rnams kyis gnyis su med pa'i ye shes kyi ngang nas bdag dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo bsgom pa la bstod par gyur/ thams cad dngos po'i rang bzhin mchog

/gdod nas thams cad bdag nyid gnas// thabs dang shes rab gnyis med pa'i// kye yi rdo rjer bdag phyag 'tshal// bdag med mas ni mgul nas 'khyud// dbu skra ser po gyen du 'bar// zhal brgyad pa la spyan gsum pa// mgon po de la gus phyag 'tshal// spyi bo'i gdan steng nag po mdzes// dkar dang dmar po g.yas dang g.yon// gang gi lhag ma'i zhal rnams ni// gnas pa de la gus phyag 'tshal// glang po rta bong glang rnga mo// skyes pa khyi dang ma her bcas// g.yas pa'i phyag brgyad la gnas pa'i// thod pa 'dzin la bdag phyag 'tshal// sa dang chu dang rlung dang me// zla nyi gshin rje gsang ba pa// g.yon pa'i phyag brgyad la gnas pa'i// thod pa 'dzin la bdag phyag 'tshal// zhabs bzhi yis ni bdud bzhi po// mnyam par mnan cing gcer bu nyid// nyi mar zhabs g.yas brkyang mdzad sngo// gar mdzad de la bdag phyag 'tshal// 'khor lo bzhi yi bdag nyid mdzes// 'dzag pa'i mgo bos rnam par brgyan// de bzhin gshegs pa rnam dag pa'i// phyag rgya lnga yis yang dag brgyan// sna tshogs rdo rjes spyi bor mtshan// dpral bar rigs kyi bdag po nyid// dam pa'i dga' ba yang dag thob// bde chen de la bdag phyag 'tshal// gaṃ las skyes pa'i gau rī shar// yan lag gnag cing g.yon na nya// g.yas pa na ni gri gug 'dzin// tshangs pa mnan la= tsaṃ las byung ba'i chom rkun ma// btsod kyi kha dog lho phyogs su// phyag na phag dang cang te'u bsnams// dbang po mnan la= baṃ las skyes pa'i ser mo nub// ro langs ma ni nye dbang mnan// phyag g.yon lhung bzed g.yas pa yis// rus sbal bsnams la bdag phyag 'tshal// ghasma rī ni byang gi sgor// ljang khu ghaṃ las byung ba yi// phyag na sbrul dang thod pas brel// drag po mnan la= gshin rje mnan cing baṃ las byung*// g.yon na dgra s+t+wa seng ge g.yas// dbang ldan du ni 'jigs gzugs ma// phyag 'tshal puk+ka sī sngon la// ri khrod ma dkar shaṃ las byung*// me ru gnod sbyin steng du gnas// g.yon na gsil byed g.yas pa yis// dge slong bsnams la=

gtum mo nam mkha'i sngo bsangs ma// srin por tsaṃ las byung ba yi// g.yon na thod pa 'khor lo g.yas// phyag 'tshal srin po mnan khyod la// ḍaṃ las byung ba'i g.yung mo ni// rlung mtshams thags bzang ris steng gshegs// phyag g.yas rdo rje g.yon sdigs mdzub// sna tshogs mdog la bdag phyag 'tshal// skyil krung phyed pa'i gar gyis gnas// phyag rgya lnga yis rnam par brgyan// gcer bu spyan gsum thams cad la// bdag ni gus pas phyag 'tshal lo// phung po khams ni rnam dag pa// byang chub sems las byung ba yi// bde rab ster ni thams cad la// dngos po kun gyis phyag 'tshal lo// nyid kyi g.yas pa'i phyag bzung ba'i// phyag mtshan sa bon las byung ba'i// bde chen 'dod pa thams cad la// rtag tu yang dag phyag 'tshal lo// gang zhig nyi zla kha sbyor nas sa bon// gnyis las skyes pa'i gtso bo rig mar bcas// nyid kyis nyid kyi dkyil 'khor 'di la ni// 'jig rten gsum po sprul par mdzad dang ldan// 'di las 'di dag thams cad ma lus pa'i// zhi ba bde stsol rig ma sdud mdzad pa// shes rab chags pas bdud rtsi ro nyid kyis// gnas su zhi ba de la phyag 'tshal lo// mkha' 'gro ma gtso kyai rdo rje// lha mo 'khor lo bcas bstod pas// bdag gis bsod nams gang thob pa// des ni 'jig rten de mtshungs shog/ ces sh+lo ka nyi shu pas bstod/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta stu ti ra badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ rin chen 'byung ldan gyi yan lag go /bcu pa bskyed pa'i rim pa'i ting nge 'dzin rnam dag dang bcas pa bsgom pa ni/ oṃ de wa pi tsu badz+ra hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ swā hā/ snying po/ oṃ badz+ra karta ri he badz+ra ya hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ swā hā/ nye ba'i snying po/ oṃ aṣ+ṭā na nā ya/ pid+ga la ud+dha ke sha war+dha ma ne/ tsa tur bing+sha ti ne trā ya/ ṣo ḍa sha bhū dzā ya/ kriṣ+ṇa dzī mū ta wa pu ṣe/ ka pā la mā la a nai kadhā ri ṇe/

āt+ma krū ra tsit+ta ya/ ar+dhen+du daṃ ṣ+ṭi ṇe/ oṃ mā ra ya mār ya/ kā ra ya kā ra ya/ gardza ya gardza ya/ tardza ya tardza ya/ sho ṣa ya sho ṣa ya/ sap+ta sā ga rā na/ ban+dha ban+dha/ nā ga aṣ+ṭa kā na/ gri h+na gri h+na sha trūṃ/ ha hā/ hi hī/ hu hū/ he hai/ ho hau/ haṃ haḥhūm̐ phaṭ swā hā/ rtsa sngags/ oṃ gau rī gaṃ swā hā/ oṃ tsau rī tsaṃ swā hā/ oṃ bai tā lī baṃ swā hā/ oṃ ghasma rī ghaṃ swā hā/ oṃ puk+ka sī paṃ swā hā/ oṃ sha wa rī shaṃ swā hā/ oṃ tsaṇ+ḍā lī tsaṃ swā hā/ ḍom+bi nī ḍāṃ swā hā/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhes gtso bo yab yum nas me ri'i bar rim pa bzhin du gsal btab/ de nas rnam dag bsgom pa/ snying rje'i spyan ni dmar po ste// rdo rje gsum gyi dag pa'i spyan// byams pa'i thugs las yan lag gnag /bsdu ba'i dngos po bzhi yis ni// zhabs ni rnam pa bzhi zhes brjod// zhal brgyad rnam par thar pa brgyad// phyag ni stong pa bcu drug nyid// gug kyed kyis ni sangs rgyas lnga// gdug pa 'dul phyir khro bor bcas// gzugs la dkar mor rtag tu bshad// sgra la chom rkun ma rab grags// dri yi cha la ro langs ma// ro la ghasma rī rab grags// sha yis puk+ka sī ru byas// de bzhin khrag gis ri khrod ma// gdol pa mo ni khu bar brjod// g.yung mo rkang dang tshil bu dag /pags pa byang chub yan lag bdun// rus pa bden pa bzhi po nyid// de la bde stong dbyer med kyis rgyas btab nas bsgom pa ni don dam de bzhin nyid kyi dag pa'o// gnyis pa ngag gi zhen pa bzlog pa'i phyir du bzlas pa bya ba ni/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhes pas lha mo brgyad zhal du bsdus te/ yum gyi thugs zla dkyil gyi a'i mthar sngags kyis bskor ba las 'od zer zhi rgyas dbang drag bzhi'i rim pas/ thig gu bsgril ba/ rma bya'i sboms/ lcags sgrog 'khyil ba/ mda'i shugs lta bu rim pa bzhin sbyar te/ yum gyi zhal nas yab kyi zhal du zhugs/

a wa dhū tī nas mar song*/ rdo rje nor bu nas yum gyi pad+mar phab/ pad+ma nas byung ste yang yum gyi zhal nas yab kyi zhal du zhugs te 'khor bar dmigs la/ oṃ de wa pi tsu badz+ra hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ swā hā/ snying po/ oṃ badz+ra karta ri he badz+ra ya hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ swā hā/ nye ba'i snying po/ oṃ aṣ+ṭā na nā ya/ pid+ga la ud+dha ke sha war+dha ma ne/ tsa tur bing+sha ti ne trā ya/ ṣo ḍa sha bhū dzā ya/ kriṣ+ṇa dzī mū ta wa pu ṣe/ ka pā la mā la a ne kadhā ri ṇe/ a ma ta krū ra tsit+ta ya/ ar+dhen+du daṃṣ+ṭi ṇe/ oṃ mā ra ya mā ra ya/ kā ra ya kā ra ya/ gardza ya gardza ya/ tardza ya tardza ya/ sho ṣa ya sho ṣa ya/ sap+ta sā ga rā na/ ban+dha ban+dha/ nā ga aṣ+ṭa kā na/ gri h+na gri h+na sha trūṃ/ hi hī/ hu hu/ he hai/ ho hau/ haṃ haḥhūm̐ phaṭ swā hā/

rtsa sngags/ oṃ aṃ swā hā zhes bzla/ 'khor rnams kyi gang zlos pa yum gyi tshab byas de'i thugs kar zla dkyil gyi steng du so so'i sa bon la sngags kyis bskor bar dmigs te/ oṃ gau rī gaṃ swā hā/ oṃ tsau rī tsaṃ swā hā/ oṃ bai tā lī baṃ swā hā/ oṃ ghasma rī ghaṃ swā hā/ oṃ puk+ka sī paṃ swā hā/ oṃ sha wa rī shaṃ swā hā/ oṃ tsaṇ+ḍa lī tsaṃ swā hā/ oṃ ḍom+bi nī ḍaṃ swā hā/ ces so sor bzlas pa bya'o// de'i thun zhabs thams cad la/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ oṃ badz+ra dhū pe āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ de bzhin du dhū pe'i gnas su/ gan+dhe= nai wi d+ya= ā lo ke= bcas mchod pa lnga dang*/ khyod ni rnal 'byor ma tshogs yongs su bskor// khyod ni nyid kyi thugs kyis khyod dgongs 'grub// khyod ni rgyu dang mi rgyu 'khor ba kun 'grub pa// snying rje'i shugs kyis sems can byang chub tu// kun rdzob sgyu ma byang chub bsgrubs pa'i yid// dgyes pa rdo rje dpal ldan he ru ka la bstod// ces bstod pa bya ste yi ge brgya pa bzlas nas smon lam btab ste/ yum yab la/ de he ru ka zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa'i nga rgyal gyis las dang po'i spyod pa ci rigs pa bya'o/ /gsum pa gzhan du bshad do// bzhi pa thun mtshams kyi chos la/ mdun du chos kyi 'byung gnas gru gsum pa'i nang gi steng du pad+ma dkar po dang*/ bar du nag po dang*/ 'og tu dmar po rnams 'dab ma brgyad pa brtsegs pa/ rang gi spyi bo'i sku rdo rje las 'od zer dkar po 'phros pas gzugs med srid pa'i lha tshogs nas rgyal chen rigs bzhi'i bar gyi lha tshogs rnams 'od kyis bsdus nas mdun gyi pad+ma dkar po'i dbus su oṃ dkar po cig tu gyur/ snying ga'i thugs rdo rje las 'od zer nag po 'phros pas phyogs skyong bcu dang pha ma la sogs pa 'od kyis bsdus nas pad+ma nag po'i dbus su hūm̐ nag po cig tu gyur/

mgrin pa'i gsung rdo rje las 'od zer dmar po 'phros pas sa steng gi mi/ sa 'og gi klu/ dmyal ba yi dwags byol song thams cad 'od kyis bsdus nas pad+ma dmar po'i dbus su āḥdamar po cig tu gyur/ yi ge gsum po dag las 'od zer 'phros/ sangs rgyas mchod/ sems can gyi don byas nas tshur 'dus pa las oṃ las 'khor lo dkar po oṃ gyis mtshan pa/ hūm̐ las rdo rje nag po hūm̐ gis mtshan pa/ āḥlas pad+ma dmar po āḥyis mtshan par gyur/ de las 'od zer 'phros/ sangs rgyas mchod/ sems can gyi don byas nas tshur 'dus pa las 'khor lo las sku rdo rje sku mdog dkar po rang 'od kyi rig ma dang zhal sbyar ba/ rdo rje las thugs rdo rje sku mdog nag po rang 'od kyi rig ma dang zhal sbyar ba/ pad+ma las gsung rdo rje sku mdog dmar po rang 'od kyi rig ma dang zhal sbyar ba/ de thams cad kyang zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa g.yas rdo rje/ g.yon dril bu bsnams pa/ zhabs g.yas brkyang bas bzhugs pa/ rang gi gnas gsum gyi lha las 'od zer 'phros pas/ dam tshig sems dpa' rang 'dra ba'i ye shes sems dpa' gsum spyan drangs/ gau rī dzaḥtsau rī hūm̐/ bai tā lī baṃ/ ghasma rī hoḥ zhes dgug gzhug bcing mnyes byas la/ slar yang 'od zer 'phros pas lha mo bdud rtsi'i bum chu thogs pa dpag tu med pa spyan drangs/ de rnams kyis dbang bskur bas sku rdo rje la rnam par snang mdzad/ thugs rdo rje la mi bskyod pa/ gsung rdo rje la snang ba mtha' yas kyis dbu brgyan par gyur/ yang rang gi gnas gsum gyi lha las mchod pa'i lha mo rnams spros te mchod par gyur/ oṃ dzaḥham̐'u baṃ hoḥkhaṃ raṃ āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ mchod yon/ oṃ ni ri ti hūm̐ khaṃ āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ zhabs bsil/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ oṃ badz+ra dhū pe āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ de bzhin du dhū pe'i gnas su/ gan+dhe= nai wi d+ya=

ā lo ke= lngas mchod/ gtor ma'i 'og tu yaṃ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor dud kha gzhu'i dbyibs lta bu tha ma gnyis ba dan gyis mtshan pa/ de'i steng du raṃ las me'i dkyil 'khor dmar po gru gsum pa/ de'i steng du a las thod pa phyi dkar la nang dmar ba/ nang gi dbus su mi'i sha dang byang chub kyi sems/ shar du glang po che'i sha dang dri chen/ lhor rta'i sha dang dri chu/ nub tu ba lang gi sha dang rak+ta/ byang du khyi'i sha dang brgyungs pa/ de rnams kyi phyi'i rnam pa oṃ/ srog āḥde'i steng du zla phyed rdo rje'i rtse mo la hūm̐ gis mtshan pa/ mgo thur du blta ba/ rlung gis me sbar thod pa bsros/ sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga khol bas/ oṃ dang āḥlas 'od zer spros te zla phyed rdo rje hūm̐ dang bcas pa las ye shes kyi bdud rtsi phab/ dam tshig gi bdud rtsi dang gnyis su med par 'dres par gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ lan gsum brjod/ mthar zla phyed rdo rje yang thod pa'i nang du lhung ste zhu bas bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin du gyur/ gtor ma'i mgron thams cad kyi ljags kyi rtse mo las rdo rje nas 'bru tsam pa de las 'od zer sbu gu can byung bas gtor ma la reg ste 'od zer gyi sbu gus bdud rtsi drangs nas gsol bar gyur/ oṃ in+d+ra/ ya mā/ dzā la/ yak+ṣa/ bhū ta/ ba ni/ wā yu/ rak+ṣa/ tsan+d+ra/ sur+ya/ mā ta/ pa byā tā la/ pa tā la/ aṣ+ṭa/ sa byā swā hā/ i daṃ/ ba liṃ/ bhuñdza/ dziṃ ga /puṣ+pe/ dhū pa/ maṃ sa/ bid+ga/ at+ma/ sarba/ kan+dza swā hā/ khan+ti/ khu ti/ bi ta ga ta/ oṃ a kā ro mu khaṃ sarba dharmā ṇī ad+ya nut+pan na twā ta oṃ āḥhūm̐ phaṭ swā hā/ lan gsum brjod/ khyod ni rnal 'byor ma tshogs yongs su bskor// khyod ni nyid kyi thugs kyis khyod dgongs 'grub// khyod ni rgyu dang mi rgyu 'khor ba kun 'grub pa// snying rje'i shugs kyis sems can byang chub tu// kun rdzob sgyu ma byang chub bsgrubs pa'i yid// dgyes pa rdo rje dpal ldan he ru ka la bstod//

yi ge brgya pa lan gsum brjod nas/ gtor ma'i mgron rnams mnyes nas ha ha/ hi hī/ hu hū/ he hai/ ho hau/ haṃ haḥzhes ye shes kyi gad mo bcu gnyis sgrogs shing*/ sgrub pa po khyod kyi yid la ci 'dod pa bdag cag rnams kyis bsgrub par bya'o zhes khas len par gyur/ lha chen brgyad po 'khor bcas dang*// klu chen brgyad po 'khor bcas dang*// 'jig rten skyong ba brgyad rnams dang*// gnod sbyin tshogs rnams ma lus dang*// 'byung po'i tshogs rnams ma lus dang*// srin po'i tshogs rnams= yi dwags tshogs= sha za'i tshogs= smyo byed tshogs= brjed byed tshogs= mkha' 'gro'i tshogs rnams ma lus dang*// de la sogs pa 'byung po'i tshogs// ma lus 'khor dang bcas pa kun// 'dir gshegs bdag la dgongs su gsol// mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di snoms la// rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor bcas la// nad med tshe dang dbang phyug dang*// dpal dang grags dang skal pa bzang*// longs spyod rgya chen kun thob cing*// dbang dang mngon spyod dgra 'joms dang*// dgar dang bsad dang dgug pa dang*// zhi dang rgyas la sogs pa yi// las kyi dngos grub bdag la stsol// dam tshig can gyis bdag la srungs// dngos grub kun gyi stongs grogs mdzod// dus min 'chi dang nad rnams dang*// gdon dang bgegs rnams med par mdzod// rmi lam ngan dang mtshan ma ngan// mkha' 'gro'i byad sogs med par mdzod// 'jig rten bde zhing lo legs dang*// bde legs phun sum tshogs pa dang*// yid la 'dod pa kun rdzogs shog/ ces phrin las bcol/ yi ge brgya pa brjod/ muḥgator ma'i mgron rnams rang bzhin gyi gnas su gshegs par gyur/ chos skyong gi gtor ma gtong bar 'dod na skabs 'di nyid du gtang bar bya'o// de nas cang te'u dkrol zhing*/ kol+la i reṭ+ṭi a bo la/ mum+mu ṇi re kak+ko la/ gha ṇa kri pi ṭā ho badz+dza i/ kā ru ṇe ki a i ṇa ro lā/

ta hiṃ ba la khādz+dza ī/ ga ḍeṃ ma a ṇā pidz+dza a i/ ha le ka liñdza ra pā ṇi a i/ du na dhu ra badz+dza a i/ tsa u sa ma kats+tsha ri si h+la/ kaspu ra lā i a i/ mā la i in+dha ṇa sā li dza/ ta he bhi ru kha i a i/ pheṃ kha ṇa khe ṭa ka ran+te/ shud+dha a shud+dhaṇ+ṇa ma ṇi a i/ ni raṃ su aṅga tsa ḍi wa/ ta hiṃ dza sa ra wa pā ṇi a i/ mā la a tse kun+tu ru bā ḍa i/ ḍāṃṇ+ḍi ma ta hiṃ ṇ+ṇa badz+dza a i/ rigs su skyes dang dam tshig can// smyo med kyai yi rdo rje ston// bla ma la gus snying rjer ldan// skye zhing skye bar 'gyur bar shog /lag pa rdo rje dril bu 'khrol// zab mo'i chos ni klog pa dang*// btsun mo'i khu ba mnyam zasacan// skye zhing skye bar 'gyur bar shog /kun tu sangs rgyas thams cad kyi// rdo rje 'chang chen go 'phang ldan// dge ba 'di yis thob 'gyur zhing*// 'gro ba lngas kyang thob par shog /byang chub rdo rje bsngags pa yi// rdzogs pa'i byang chub phyir spyod dang*// rdzogs sangs rgyas kyi spyod pa gang*// bdag kyang de nyid spyod par shog/ mngon par rtogs pa'i rim pa'o/// / ༄༅// dkyil 'khor gyi las rim la/ sa chog /sta gon/ dkyil 'khor zhag gi cho ga gsum las/ dang po la lnga las/ gnas brtag pa ni/ tshal dang skye bo med gnas dang*// byang chub sems dpa'i khyim dang ni// dkyil 'khor khang pa'i nang du yang*// dkyil 'khor dam pa rab tu bzheng*// zhes gsungs pa'i gnas so// gnyis pa sa bslang ba ni/ mchod pa dang gtor ma bshams la/ sngon du 'byung po thams cad pa'i gtor ma bsang sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las gtor ma'i 'og tu yaṃ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor dud kha sogs nas/ mthar zla phyed rdo rje yang thod pa'i nang du zhu ba dang bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin du gyur zhes byin gyis brlab/ dril bu dkrol zhing ngag tu/ in+d+ra sogs sam bsdus par a kā ro nyid kyis kyang rung ste lan gsum brjod/

lha chen brgyad po 'khor dang bcas// zhes pas 'phrin las bcol/ yig brgya'i mthar muḥ zhes brjod/ se gol lan gsum gtog gtor mgron rang gnas su gshegs/ gzhan yang gang dag gsang sngags zab mo nyan pa la mi mos shing phyag rgya sna tshogs blta ba la mi dbang*/ ting nge 'dzin zab mo bsgom pa la bar du gcod par byed pa'i gnod byed 'byung po'i tshogs thams cad la gtor ma'i lhag ma 'di sbyin no// gtor ma 'dis tshim par gyis la gnod pa dang 'tshe ba'i bsam pa thams cad nye bar zhi nas phan pa byang chub kyi sems dang ldan pa rang rang so so'i gnas dang rten gang yin la phar dengs shig /suṃ bha ni brjod cing rol mos bskrad/ de nas/ oṃ rak+ṣa rak+ṣa hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ swā hā/ nas/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta stu ti ra badz+ra swa bha wa at+ma ko3haṃ/ bar gyis/ yan lag drug pa'i bskyed rim bsgom ste/ mthar 'khor rnams yum/ yum yab la/ de he ru ka zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa'i skur gyur/ zhes dkyil 'khor bsdus nas phyag gnyis pa'i nga rgyal gyis dkyil 'khor 'byung ba'i dbus su dri yi thig le gcig bya/ me tog gi tshom bu gcig dgram/ de la baṃ las sa'i lha mo lte ba yan chad sa gseb nas 'thon pa/ sku mdog gser btso ma lta bu zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yas pa khas len gyi phyag rgya dang*/ g.yon pa rin po che'i bum pa bsnams pa/ rin po che'i rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan nas/ bdag gis ci bgyid zer ba cig tu gyur/ oṃ tshur spyon tshur spyon lha mo che// sa yi lha mo 'jig rten yum// rin chen kun gyis rab gang ba'i// mchog gi rgyan gyis rab tu brgyan// mgul do zhabs gdub sil sil can// rdo rje sems dpa' rab mchod ma// mchod yon 'di ni bzhes mdzod la// dkyil 'khor las rnams rab tu sgrubs/ hrīḥhī hī hī hī baṃ swā hā/ zhes pas ye shes pa spyan drangs/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥdam tshig pa dang gnyis su med par gyur/

oṃ ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha hūm̐ swā hā/ zhes pa sngon du 'gro ba'i oṃ puṣ+pe pra tīts+tsha hūm̐ swā hā/ oṃ dhū pe pra tīts+tsha hūm̐ swā hā/ gan+dhe= nai wid+ya= ā lo ke= shap+ta pra tīts+tsha hūm̐ swā hā/ mchod pa lnga rol mo dang bcas pas mchod/ de nas/ gtor ma bsangs sbyang*/ a kā ro lan gsum gyis byin gyis rlabs/ oṃ pri thi bī de bī sa pa ri wā ra na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yo bi shwa mu khe bh+yaḥ sarba thā khaṃ ud+ga te s+pha ra ṇa i maṃ ga ga na khaṃ gṛh+ṇe daṃ la liṃ di swā hā/ lan gsum gyis 'bul/ ma ma rin chen sna tshogs 'dzin// kyai yi rdo rje khro mchod pa'i// lha mo khyod ni dpang du 'gyur// che ge bdag ni dkyil 'khor bri// zhes gsol ba btab pas/ sa'i lha mos/ sa'i phyogs 'dir khyod kyis dkyil 'khor bris shig ces gnang ba sbyin nas ye shes sems dpa' gshegs/ dam tshig sems dpa' de nyid du thim par gyur/ gsum pa bya bas sbyang ba ni/ las dang bya bas sbyang ba/ brkos la sa'i skyon lnga bsal nas stegs bu ngos rer tshon gsum gyis lhag pa'i khru gsum/ dbus cung zad mtho ba/ mtha' bags kyis dma' zhing zhal bas 'jam par byas pa/ ba'i rnam lnga'i dri bzang gis rkyang nul legs par bya'o// sngags dang ting nge 'dzin gyis sbyang ba ni/ de nas rang nyid he ru ka'i nga rgyal gyis lag pa gnyis sa la bzhag la sa'i nyes pa'i skyon thams cad dag par bsams la snying po'am nye snying ngam rtsa sngags lan gcig bzla'o// bzhi pa sa srung ba ni/ raṃ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi dbus hūm̐ las ral gri de'i lte ba la hūm̐ de'i 'od zer las rdo rje rgya gram phyogs mtshams thams cad du gtams par bsam zhing*/ oṃ rak+ṣa rak+ṣa hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ swā hā/ brjod pas sa gzhi bsrung*/ oṃ me di ni swā hā/ ye shes kyi sa bkug nas de la bstim/ lnga pa sa gzung ba ni/ sta gon gyi phyir mchod pa dang rten bsham/

gnas nye bar brgyan par bya'o// nub dang po'i 'o// gnyis pa sta gon gyi cho ga la bzhi las/ dang po bgegs bsal ba ni/ gnas der bum pa la sogs pa'i sta gon gyi yo byad dang*/ mchod pa'i rdzas lag len bzhin du bshams te/ slob dpon stegs bu'i dbus su phyag rgya drug gis brgyan te phyi dro'i dus su in+d+ra'i gtor ma nas bzlas pa'i bar bsnyen pa bzhin du byas nas 'khor mi bsdu bar bzlas pa ci rigs par bya/ mchod g.yog pa bzhi gau rī ma sogs lha mo bzhi'i nga rgyal gyis rdo rje dril bu thogs/ thog mar shar nas/ rang nyid skad cig gis gau rī ma nag mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum ma/ mche ba gtsigs pa/ gcer bu phyag rgya lnga dang ldan zhing*/ thod pa skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan dang*/ skam po lnga bcu'i phreng bas brgyan pa/ g.yas gri gug /g.yon nya ro hi ta bsnams pa/ zhabs g.yon brkyang skyil krung phyed pa'i gar gyis pad+ma dang tshangs pa'i gdan la bzhugs par gyur/ oṃ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥkhaṃ raṃ āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ mchod yon/ oṃ ni ri ti hūm̐ khaṃ āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ zhabs bsil/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ oṃ badz+ra dhū pe āḥhūm̐ swā hā/

de bzhin du dhū pe'i gnas su gan+dhe= nai wi d+ya= ā lo ke= mchod yon sogs dang rnam lngas mchod/ khyod ni rnal 'byor ma tshogs yongs su bskor// khyod ni nyid kyi thugs kyis khyod dgongs 'grub// khyod ni rgyu dang mi rgyu 'khor ba kun 'grub pa// snying rje'i thugs kyis sems can byang chub tu// kun rdzob sgyu ma byang chub sgrub pa'i yid// dgyes pa rdo rje dpal ldan he ru ka la bstod// de nas bskul ba ni/ de bzhin gshegs pa kun zhi ba// de bzhin gshegs pa kun gyi gnas// chos kun bdag med pa yi mchog /dkyil 'khor gtso bos bshad du gsol// lho phyogs nas/ rang nyid skad cig gis tsau rī ma nag mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum ma/ mche ba gtsigs pa/ gcer bu phyag rgya lnga dang ldan zhing*/ thod pa skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan dang*/ skam po lnga bcu'i phreng bas brgyan pa/ g.yas cang te'u/ g.yon phag pa bsnams pa/ zhabs g.yon brkyang skyil krung phyed pa'i gar gyis pad+ma dang dbang po'i gdan la bzhugs par gyur/ mchod bstod gong bzhin byas/ bskul ba ni/ mtshan rnams thams cad yang dag rdzogs// mtshan min thams cad rnam par spang*// kun tu bzang po sku yi mchog /dkyil 'khor gtso bos bshad du gsol// nub phyogs nas/ rang nyid skad cig gis bai tā li ser mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum ma/ mche ba gtsigs pa/ gcer bu phyag rgya lnga dang ldan zhing*/ thod pa skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan dang*/ skam po lnga bcu'i phreng bas brgyan pa/ g.yas rus sbal/ g.yon thod pa bsnams pa/ zhabs g.yon brkyang skyil krung phyed pa'i gar gyis pad+ma dang nye dbang gi gdan la bzhugs par gyur/ mchod bstod gong bzhin byas/ bskul ba ni/ zhi ba'i mchog ni chos las byung*// ye shes spyod pa rnams sbyong ba// kun tu bzang po gsung gi mchog /dkyil 'khor gtso bos bshad du gsol/ byang nas/ rang nyid skad cig gis ghasma rī ljang khu zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum ma/

mche ba gtsigs pa/ gcer bu phyag rgya lnga dang ldan zhing*/ thod pa skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan dang*/ skam po lnga bcu'i phreng bas brgyan pa/ g.yas sbrul/ g.yon thod pa bsnams pa zhabs g.yon brkyang skyil krung phyed pa'i gar gyis pad+ma dang drag po'i gdan la bzhugs par gyur/ mchod bstod gong bzhin byas/ bskul ba ni/ sems can kun gyi sems chen po// rang bzhin dag cing dri ma med// kun bzang thugs mchog kha lo bsgyur// dkyil 'khor gtso bos bshad du gsol// de nas slob dpon gyis/ yum dang bcas pa'i rten brten par bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor bdag nyid la thim zhes/ dkyil 'khor bsdus la/ bdag nyid he ru ka zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa'i skur gyur pa'i rkang mthil gnyis su hūm̐ las sna tshogs rdo rje/ mig gnyis su ma dang ṭā las nyi ma dang zla ba'i dkyil 'khor der hūm̐ las sna tshogs rdo rje re res mtshan par gyur/ rab tu myur zhing g.yo ba'i mig gis blta zhing dbus su langs te nga rgyal bskyed pa ni/ kha yi pad+ma 'dzum dang bcas// cung zad dmar ba'i mche ba 'chang*// kun+da dkar gsal so yi 'phreng*// dpal ldan khrag 'thung rnal 'byor che// sems can sgrol ba rmad du byung*// de la sogs pa'i gar gyis ni// bgegs la sogs pa bskrad par bya// zhes brjod la rdo rje dril bu bcas pas hūm̐ mdzad kyi phyag rgya byas/ shar gyi phyogs nas kha nang du bstan te bgegs la bka' bsgo ba ni/ nga ni dpal ldan snying rje'i stobs// bsrung ba'i 'khor lo sbyor ba po// rdo rje rtse mo 'bar ba yis// lus srul las skyes 'gas byas te// rmongs pa'i bdag nyid gang 'da' ba// tshal par dgas kyis gzhan du min// bde chen ye shes rdzogs 'tshang rgya// rdo rje sems dpa' dngos las skyes// lus srul po ni gang su dag /bgegs chen po rnams so sor song*/ sa phyogs 'dir bdag rdo rje slob dpon

'di zhes bya bas slob ma rnams rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thob par bya ba dang*/ sems can thams cad bla na med pa'i byang chub thob par bya ba'i phyir/ bcom ldan 'das dgyes pa rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo zhig 'bri yis/ gang su yang rung ba/ sa phyogs 'di na gnas pa'i lha dang*/ lha min dang*/ gnod sbyin dang*/ srin po dang*/ yi dwags dang*/ sha za dang*/ smyo byed dang*/ brjed byed dang*/ 'byung po dang*/ gnon po dang*/ nam mkha' lding dang*/ mi'am ci dang*/ rig pa 'dzin pa la sogs pa rgan po dang*/ rgan mo dang*/ g.yog dang 'khor du bcas pa rnams 'dir ma gnas par gzhan du dengs shig /gang dag mi 'gro ba de dag ni phyag na rdo rje rab tu 'bar ba hūm̐ ka ra shin tu khros pa ye shes kyi rdo rje chen po kun nas rab tu 'bar bas mgo bo tshal pa brgyar 'gas par gyur ta re/ zhes dang*/ namaḥs man+ta bud+dhe bh+yo/ na mo badz+ra kro dhā ya/ mahā daṃṣ+ṭo ka ṭa bhe ra bā ya/ oṃ da ka ta/ badz+ra san+to haṃ/ dar+pa ya/ oṃ a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa li hūm̐ phaṭ/ ces dang*/ rtsa sngags kyang bzla/ de rnams lan gsum brjod cing*/ dang por rdo rje gsor/ tha mar dril bu dkrol/ dbang ldan nas brtsams te hūm̐ mang po brjod cing g.yas skor du lan gsum bskor te/ he ru ka'i thugs ka'i 'od zer gyis bgegs thams cad bskrad par bsam/ slar yang dbang ldan gyi mtshams nas/ rang nyid bdag med ma'i skur gsal bar gyur/ zhes pa'i nga rgyal gyis hi mang po brjod cing g.yon skor du lan gsum bskor zhing*/ yang na dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su he ru ka'i nga rgyal gyis g.yas brkyang gis 'dug ste rdo rje dril bu gzung ba'i lag pas gar bsgyur zhing hūm̐ 'ba' zhig 'don pa dang*/ bdag med ma'i nga rgyal gyis g.yon brkyang gis 'dug ste hi 'ba' zhig brjod par bya'o// slar yang*/ rang nyid he ru ka zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa'i skur gsal bar gyur/

rang gi sems nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor de nyid kyi steng du/ hūm̐ las sna tshogs rdo rje/ de'i lte ba la hūm̐/ de las 'od zer rtse mo la rdo rje rgya gram pa dpag tu med pa 'phros pas/ 'og tu song bas rdo rje'i sa gzhi/ bar snang du song bas rdo rje'i rwa ba dang drwa ba steng du song bas rdo rje'i gur/ gzhi mo'i nyi ma las me'i 'od zer phyir 'phros pas me ri/ gzhi mo'i rdo rje rgya gram pa las rdo rje rkyang pa dpag tu med pa 'phros pas rdo rje'i drwa mig rnam bkag par gyur/ oṃ rak+ṣa rak+ṣa hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ swā hā/ rdo rje'i sa gzhi la sogs par bsam mo// gnyis pa la gsum las/ dang po lha sta gon ni/ stang stabs byas pa'i sa rdul 'phyags la/ chang dang bdud rtsi'i ril bu sbyar bas gzhal yas khang gi tshad tsam zlum por byugs pa'i dbus su dri'i thig le gru bzhi dang*/ 'khor gyi gnas phyogs mtshams brgyad du thig le zlum po re byas la/ dbus nas rim pa bzhin so so'i snying po brjod cing me tog gi tshom bu dgram mo// de nas mchod pa rnam lnga lha grangs dang mnyam pas bskor/ tshom bu'i dkyil 'khor 'di nyid rin po che sna lnga las grub pa'i gzhal yas khang nas de'i rgyas btab kyi kun gzhi dang ldan pa bar/ oṃ de wa pi tsu badz+ra hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ swā hā/ dbus kyi bdud bzhi'i gdan gyi steng du bcom ldan 'das dpal dgyes pa rdo rje zhes pa nas/ a sngon po 'od zer dang bcas pa zhes pa'i bar 'bras bu rdo rje 'dzin pa'i skabs bzhin no// de bzhin du/ oṃ gau rī gaṃ swā hā/ shar du gau rī ma nag mo sogs so so'i sngags brjod cing*/ so so'i gdan gyi steng du lha mo brgyad bdag bskyed bzhin bskyed/ gtso bo'i mig tu oṃ zhes pa nas/ mi dgyes pa med pa'i dgyes par gyur gyi bar mngon rtogs bzhin no// de nas/ rang gi snying ka'i hūm̐ sa bon las 'od zer nag po

sogs nas/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ zhes pa'i bar/ de nas mchod rdzas rnams/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ lan gsum gyis mchod rdzas thams cad bde stong gi rang bzhin du byin gyis brlabs/ de nas/ lha dgu'i thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas 'jig rten gyi khams na gzugs sdug pa sogs nas/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta pū dza badz+ra swa bhā āt+ma ko3haṃ/ zhes pa'i bar mdun bskyed bzhin phyi nang gsang ba gsum gyi mchod pa rgyas btab bcas/ bstod pa/ thams cad dngos po'i rang bzhin mchog/ sogs nas/ des ni 'jig rten de mtshungs shog/ bar dang*/ rgyas par spro na rje btsun zhe sdang rdo rjes mdzad pa'i dpal ldan dgyes mdzad ma bya'o// de nas/ bdud rtsi'i 'og tu yaṃ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor dud kha sogs nas oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a mṛ tā swa da badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ zhes bdud rtsi myang ba'i rgyas btab gyi bar byas nas/ spos kyi reng bu thogs te gsol ba gdab pa ni/ gnyis med ye shes las byung ba// khyab bdag dngos grub bdag nyid can// ston pa'i gtso bo khrag 'thung dpal// bdag med ma dang yang dag ldan// phyogs mtshams rnams kyi mkha' 'gro ma// rig pa'i lha mo rdzu 'phrul ldan// byang chub sems dpa' la sogs kun// ma lus bdag la dgongs su gsol// slob ma la ni phan pa dang*// khyed rnams la yang mchod pa'i phyir// rdo rje can bdag 'di zhes pa// nang par dkyil 'khor bri bar 'tshal// rjes su brtse bas nyer dgongs te// byin gyis brlab par mdzad du gsol// zhes gsol ba gdab bo// ( sta gon gyi dkyil 'khor rten dang brten par bcas pa rnams nam mkhar bzhugs par gyur/ zhes bya'o//) gnyis pa bum pa sta gon ni bum pa mtshan nyid dang ldan pa rgyas par bcu/ med na gnyis kyi phyi nang thams cad bkru/ gu gul gyis bdug /yungs kar la bdud rtsi 'khyil ba'i sngags brjod/

bgegs bskrad/ rang rang gi mtshan ma bris/ nang du gser/ dngul/ mu tig /mu men/ byu ru ste rin po che lnga dang*/ kan+ḍa kā ri/ dan+ḍo t+pa la/ gu gul dkar po/ dbang lag /pad+ma'i rtsa ba ste sman lnga/ nas/ gro/ til/ 'bras/ mā sha ste 'bru lnga dang*/ tsan+dan dkar po/ dzā ti/ ga pur/ gur gum/ gla rtsi ste dri lnga/ bdud rtsi lnga dang*/ slob dpon rtogs pa dang ldan na sha lnga yang gzhug /chu gtsang gis dgang*/ ras kha tshar ma nyams pas mgul pa bcings/ shing gi rtse mo'i cha las byung ba'i 'dab ma 'bras bur bcas pas kha brgyan/ ras dkar dri ma med pa'i steng du me tog gcal du bkram pa la lha dgod pa'i go rim bzhin du bzhugs su gsol/ las thams cad pa'i bum pa byang shar mtshams su bzhag /bum pa'i grangs dang mnyam pa'i mchod pa lnga tshang bar bsham/ de nas gtso bum gyi shing lo'i khar bdud rtsi dang chang sbyar bas bkang ba'i thod pa bzhag /de'i steng du rdo rje'i lte bar me tog gi 'phreng ba brgyus pa'i gzungs thag btags te/ bum pa 1$0000250 shu n+ya tā sa sbyangs/ 1$0000250stong pa'i ngang las bh+ruṃ zhu ba las rin po che'i bum pa phyi'i dbyibs bum pa nang gzhal yas khang 'od lhag ge lhang nger gyur pa'i nang du pad+ma dmar po 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte bar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor la gnas pa'i bdud bzhi'i gdan gyi steng du skad cig gis bcom ldan 'das dpal dgyes pa rdo rje sku mdog nag po zhes pa nas 1$0000250 me ri me dpung gi nang na bzhugs par gyur/ ces pa'i bar gyis bskyed/ 1$0000250gau rī dzaḥ sogs ye shes bsres mchod pa lngas mchod/ rdor dril gzung ste/ 1$0000250 thams cad dngos pa'i rang bzhin mchog /nas/ 1$0000250bde chen de la bdag phyag 'tshal/ /zhes pa'i bar gyis bstod/ gtor ma la bdud rtsi myang*/ 1$0000250 sngags kyi 'od zer gzungs thag la 'khril nas bum pa'i nang du song zhing*/ yab yum snyoms par zhugs pa'i byang chub sems kyis bum pa gang bar gyur/

gtso bo'i snying po lan brgya rtsa brgyad bzla/ mthar thod pa'i bdud rtsi bum par blug pas 1$0000250bcom ldan 'das yab yum 'od du zhu nas bum pa'i chur gyur/ de nas gau rī'i bum pa'i kha rgyan gyi gseb tu rdo rje gzungs thag dang bcas pa btsugs te/ 1$0000250 stong pa'i ngang las bh+ruṃ las rin po che'i bum pa nas/ 1$0000250'od lhag ge lhang nge bar gyur pa'i nang du skad cig gis gau rī ma sku mdog nag mo zhes sogs kyis bskyed/ gong bzhin du dgug gzhug mchod pa lngas mchod/ 1$0000250 gaṃ las skyes pa'i gau ri shar zhes sogs kyis bstod/ gtor ma la bdud rtsi myang*/ 1$0000250rdo rje de gau rī ma'i bha gar tshud pas bde stong dbyer med du lhan gyis song bar bsam zhing*/ 1$0000250 oṃ gau rī gaṃ āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas te mthar 1$0000250rdo rje bton pas rkyen byas nas bdud rtsi'i chur zhu bar gyur/ de bzhin du bum pa bdun ka shes par bya'o// bsdus pa thang sku la sogs la brten pa'i tshe bum pa gnyis la gong bzhin bkru ba sogs bca' gzhi rnams tshang bar byas te/ shū n+ya tā sa sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las bh+ruṃ zhu ba las rin po che'i bum pa phyi'i dbyibs bum pa gzhal yas khang 'od lhag ge lhang nger gyur pa'i nang du pad+ma dmar po 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte bar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor la gnas pa'i bdud bzhi'i gdan gyi steng du skad cig gis bcom ldan 'das dgyes pa rdo rje sku mdog nag po/ zhal brgyad zhabs bzhi phyag bcu drug pa/ rtsa ba'i zhal nag pa/ g.yas zhal dkar ba/ g.yon zhal dmar ba cher 'jigs pa/ lhag ma'i zhal gnyis nag pa/ steng zhal dud kha gtsigs pa/ zhal re re la spyan gsum gsum dang ldan zhing spyan rtsa dmar ba dbu skra ser po gyen du brdzes pa/ spyi bor sna tshogs rdo rjes mtshan pa/ phyag g.yas pa'i thod pa brgyad kyi dang po na glang po che dkar po/

gnyis pa na rta sngon po/ gsum pa na bong bu gwa pa/ bzhi pa na glang dmar po/ lnga pa na rnga mo thal kha/ drug pa na mi dmar po/ bdun pa na seng ge sngon po/ brgyad pa na byi la gwa pa rnams gdong nang du bstan te bsnams pa/ g.yon pa'i thod pa brgyad kyi dang po na sa'i lha mo ser mo/ gnyis pa na chu'i lha mo dkar mo/ gsum pa na rlung gi lha mo dud kha/ bzhi pa na me'i lha mo dmar mo/ lnga pa na zla ba'i lha mo dkar mo/ drug pa na nyi ma'i lha mo dmar mo/ bdun pa na gshin rje nag po/ brgyad pa na nor bdag ser po/ de thams cad kyang zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa thal mo snying kar sbyar ba zhal phyir bstan te bsnams pa/ phyag dang po gnyis kyis yum la 'khyud pa/ dbu re re la mi mgo skam po lnga lngas brgyan cing*/ rlon pa khrag 'dzag pa lnga bcu'i phreng bas do shal byas pa/ thal chen gyis lus la byugs pa/ gar gyi nyams dgu dang ldan pa/ zhabs bzhi'i g.yas pa gnyis brkyang zhing g.yon pa gnyis bskum pa'i gar stabs kyis bdud bzhi'i snying ga mnan pa/ de'i yum bdag med ma sku mdog nag mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma/ spyan gsum dmar ba/ dbu skra ser po gyen du brdzes pa g.yas gri gug /g.yon thod pa khrag gis gang ba bsnams nas yab kyi mgul nas 'khyud pa/ mi mgo skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan dang*/ rlon pa lnga bcu'i 'phreng bas do shal byas pa/ zhabs g.yas pa yab la 'khyud cing g.yon brkyang ba/ yab yum gnyis ka'i spyi bor rus pa'i 'khor lo/ rna rgyan mgul rgyan lag gdub ska rags te rus pa'i rgyan cha lngas brgyan pa/ mtshan dang dpe byad kyis spras pa/ me ri dang me dpung gi nang na bzhugs pa/ shar du gau rī ma nag mo g.yas gri gug g.yon ro hi ta'i nya bsnams pa/ lhor tsau rī ma dmar mo g.yas cang te'u g.yon phag pa bsnams pa/ nub tu bai tā li ser mo g.yas ru sbal/ g.yon thod pa bsnams pa/ byang du ghasma rī ljang khu g.yas sbrul/

g.yon rnal 'byor gyi lhung bzed bsnams pa/ dbang ldan du puk+ka sī sngon mo g.yas seng ge/ g.yon dgra s+t+wa bsnams pa/ mer sha ba ri dkar mo g.yas dge slong*/ g.yon gsil byed bsnams pa/ srin por tsaṇ+ḍā li sngon mo g.yas 'khor lo/ g.yon thod pa bsnams pa/ rlung du ḍoṃ bi nī zhal ras dkar ba/ thugs ka nag pa/ lte ba dmar ba/ mdongs mo dkar ba/ brla dang dpung pa ser ba/ lag ngar gnyis dang rkang pa'i rje ngar ljang khu/ g.yas rdo rje/ g.yon sdigs mdzub mdzad pa/ lha mo de thams cad zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma/ spyan gsum dmar ba/ dbu skra ser po gyen du brdzes pa/ rus pa'i rgyan cha lngas brgyan pa/ zhabs g.yon brkyang ba/ g.yas pa'i mthil g.yon pa'i brla la gtad de skyil krung phyed pa'i gar stabs kyis me ri dang me dpung gi nang na bzhugs par gyur/

zhes lha dgu char bskyed par bya'o// rang gi snying ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas ye shes kyi dgyes pa rdo rje lha dgu'i dkyil 'khor mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs/ gau rī dzaḥdam tshig sems dpa'i mgo thog tu ye shes sems dpa' dgug /tsau rī hūm̐/ gzhug /bai tā lī baṃ/ bcing*/ ghasma rī hoḥmi dgyes pa med par dgyes par gyur/ de nas/ rang gi snying ga'i hūm̐ sa bon las 'od zer nag po lcags kyu'i rnam pa'i tshul gyis phyung nas des khams gsum du bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas thams cad spyan drangs la/ oṃ gau rī gaṃ āḥhūm̐ swā hā sogs lha mo brgyad kyi sngags kyis mchod/ oṃ a bhi ṣiñtsa tu māṃ sarba ta thā ga ta/ zhes gsol ba btab pas sangs rgyas de rnams he ru ka'i rnam pa'i gzugs kyis de bzhin gshegs pa lnga'i bdag nyid kyi bdud rtsi lngas gang ba'i bum pas dbang bskur/ dbang bskur ba na me tog gi char 'bab par 'gyur ro// rnga'i sgra 'byung bar 'gyur ro// gzugs rdo rje ma la sogs pa rnams kyis mchod par bya'o// rdo rje'i glu spyan ma la sogs pa rnams kyis blangs bar bya'o// dbang bskur nas chu cung zad yar 'khyil ba las gtso bo yab yum/ puk+ka sī dang gau rī ma la mi bskyod pa/ sha wa rī dang tsau rī ma la rnam par snang mdzad/ tsaṇ+ḍa lī dang*/ bai tā lī la rin chen 'byung ldan/ ḍom+bi nī dang ghasma rī la snang ba mtha' yas kyis dbu brgyan par gyur/ mchod pa ni/ hūm̐ gis mchod rdzas kyi bgegs bsal/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ lan gsum gyis/ mchod rdzas thams cad bde stong du byin gyis rlabs nas mchod par gyur/ me tog bzang po mdzes shing gtsang*// gtsang ma'i gnas skyes 'di rnams ni// bdag ni gus pas 'bul lags kyis// so sor bzhes te dgyes par mdzod/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ yid dga' snying po ro mchog ldan// bdug pa bla re'i dri mchog ni// bdag=

so sor= dhū pe= gtsang zhing bzang la dge ba'i dri// skyes gnas gtsang mar ldan 'di rnams// bdag= so sor= gan+dhe= gtsang zhing gtsang la dge ba'i bshos// skyes gnas gtsang mar ldan 'di rnams/ bdag ni= so sor= nai wi d+yaṃ= dmar gsal sdug pa dag cing gtsang*// dge zhing mun sel mar me 'di// bdag ni= so sor= ā lo ke= de las gzhan yang mchod pa'i tshogs// rol mo sgra snyan yid 'ong ldan// bdag= so sor= oṃ badz+ra shap+ta āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ zhes mchod/ khyod ni rnal 'byor ma tshogs yongs su bskor// khyod ni nyid kyi thugs kyis khyod dgongs 'grub// khyod ni rgyu dang mi rgyu 'khor ba kun 'grub pa// snying rje'i shugs kyis sems can byang chub tu// kun rdzob sgyu ma byang chub bsgrubs pa'i yid// dgyes pa rdo rje dpal ldan he ru ka la bstod// ces bstod/ de nas/ bdud rtsi'i 'og tu yaṃ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor dud kha gzhu'i dbyibs lta bu tha ma gnyis ba dan gyis mtshan pa/ de'i steng du raṃ las me'i dkyil 'khor dmar po gru gsum pa/ de'i steng du a las thod pa phyi dkar la nang dmar ba/ nang gi dbus su mi'i sha dang byang chub kyi sems/ shar du glang po che'i sha dang dri chen/ lhor rta'i sha dang dri chu/ nub tu ba lang gi sha dang rak+ta/ byang du khyi'i sha dang brgyungs pa/ de rnams kyi phyi'i rnam pa oṃ/ srog āḥde'i steng du zla phyed rdo rje'i rtse mo la hūm̐ gis mtshan pa/ mgo thur du blta ba/ rlung gis me sbar thod pa bsros/ sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga khol bas/ oṃ dang āḥlas 'od zer spros te zla phyed rdo rje hūm̐ dang bcas pa las ye shes kyi bdud rtsi phab/ dam tshig gi bdud rtsi dang gnyis su med par 'dres par gyur/ oṃ āḥham̐'u lan gsum brjod/ mthar zla phyed rdo rje yang thod pa'i nang du lhung ste zhu bas bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin du gyur/ gtso 'khor thams cad kyi ljags kyi rtse mo las rdo rje nas 'bru tsam pa/

de'i 'od zer gyi sbu gus bdud rtsi drangs nas gsol bas shin tu mnyes par gyur/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a mṛ tā swa da badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ zhes bdud rtsi phul/ sngags kyi 'od zer gzungs thag la 'khril nas bum pa'i nang du song zhing*/ yab yum snyoms par zhugs pa'i byang chub sems kyis bum pa gang bar gyur/ gtso bo'i snying po nyer gcig bzla/ 'khor rnams kyi sngags lan bdun re bzlas pa'i mthar/ lha rnams bdud rtsi'i chur zhu bar gyur/ las bum/ shū n+ya tā sa bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las bh+ruṃ zhu ba las rin po che'i bum pa phyi'i dbyibs bum pa nang gzhal yas khang 'od lhag ge lhang nger gyur pa'i nang du hūm̐ las khro bo bdud rtsi 'khyil pa sku mdog sngon po g.yas rdo rje dang g.yon sdigs mdzub/ khro bo'i rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ pad nyi'i gdan la g.yon brkyang gi stabs kyis me ri dang me dpung gi nang na bzhugs par gyur/ oṃ badz+ra pūṣ+pe āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ sogs/ nai wīd+ya āḥhūm̐ bar gyis mchod pa lngas mchod/ thugs kar nyi dkyil la hūm̐ sngon po las sngags kyis bskor bar gyur/ oṃ a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa li hūm̐ phaṭ ces brgya rtsa brgyad bzla/ khro bo bdud rtsi 'khyil ba mi bzhu bar sku las bdud rtsi babs pas bum pa gang lha de nyid dkyil 'khor gyi byang shar mtshams su bzhugs nas bdag cag dpon slob 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyi las ma grub kyi bar du bgegs ma rungs pa rnams srung bar mdzad du gsol/ zhes 'phrin las bcol lo// grub na dkyil 'khor gyi shar phyogs su sbyin bsreg bya'o/ /gsum pa slob ma sta gon la chos bcu gnyis las/ dang por slob ma'i bar chad zhi ba'i phyir in+d+ra'i sngags kyis gtor ma btang*/ de nas yol ba'i phyi rol tu las thams cad pa'i chus khrus bya gos gtsang ma gyon bla ma la maṇ+ḍal phul te/ gnyis pa gsang sngags kyi chos la mos pa 'jug pa ni/

me tog dang bcas pa'i thal mo sbyar nas gnas pa la 'di skad ces brjod par bya ste/ sngags kyi dngos grub don gnyer gang*// dkyil 'khor 'dir ni gzhug par bya// bsod nams 'dod pa de las gzhan// gzhan ni 'jig rten pha rol gnyer// slar yang dad dang ldan pa yis// 'jig rten pha rol la dmigs te// blo ldan dkyil 'khor gzhug par bya// 'di yi 'bras bu mi gnyer te// gal te 'di 'bras don gnyer na/ 'jig rten pha rol 'grub mi 'gyur// 'jig rten pha rol la dmigs na// 'bad pa med par 'di 'bras 'grub// gsum pa thun mong ma yin pa'i sems bskyed kyi don du gsol ba gdab pa ni/ dga' chen khyod bdag ston pa ste// slob dpon khyod ni dgongs su gsol// byang chub sems dpa'i tshul bstan pa// sdom pa rnams kyang bdag la stsol// sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te// skyabs gsum dag kyang bdag la stsol// thar pa chen po'i grong mchog tu// mgon pos bdag ni 'jug par 'tshal// zhes lan gsum gsol ba gdab tu gzhug /bzhi pa slob dpon gyis gsang sngags kyi theg par blo dgug par bya ba ni/ bu tshur theg pa chen po la// khyod ni tshul chen snod yin gyi// gsang sngags spyod tshul chog ni// khyod la yang dag bstan par bya// rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas gang 'das dang*// gang dag de bzhin ma byon dang*// da ltar byung ba'i rdzogs sangs rgyas// 'gro la phan phyir bzhugs pa rnams// de dag kun gyis gsang sngags kyi// cho ga bzang po 'di mkhyen pas// dpa' bos byang chub shing drung du// thams cad mkhyen pa tshad med brnyes// gsang sngags sbyor ba mnyam med pa// skyob pa sangs rgyas he ru ka /bdud sde shin tu mi bzad pa'i// dpung chen dag kyang de yis bcom// de bas kun mkhyen thob bya'i phyir// bu yis blo gros 'di gyis shig/ ces brjod/ lnga pa nyan par rna ba gtad par bskul ba ni/

rtog pa thams cad legs par bsdus nas ni// shin tu bsam pa bzang pos legs par nyon// brjed ngas blo la he ru ka sogs pa'i// bde bar gshegs pa rnams kyis byin mi brlob// ces brjod/ drug pa rgyud dag par bya ba'i don du lnga rnam dag bya ba ni/ bdag gis sdig pa bgyis pa dang*// bgyid du stsal dang yi rang ba// sangs rgyas spyan sngar mchis nas su// de dag thams cad bshags par bya// sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' dang*// rang rgyal dgra bcom 'gro rnams kyis// sgom dang bzlas brjod bsod rnams la// de la bdag ni yi rang ngo*// bdag gi dge ba'i las rnams 'di dag gis// 'jig rten 'dir ni myur du 'tshang rgya shog /'gro la phan phyir chos rnams ston byed cing*// sems can sdug bsngal mang pos gzir las grol// sems bskyed mngon par sangs rgyas dang*// chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba dang*// byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyi mchog /de la bdag ni skyabs su mchi// sangs rgyas 'byung ba ji lta bar// skal ldan byang chub sems dpa' yis// byang chub sems ni bskyed pa ltar// de nyid du ni sems bskyed do// zhes lan gsum brjod du gzhug /bdun pa slob ma rab gnas ni/ slob ma skad cig gis he ru ka phyag gnyis par bskyed la/ slob dpon gyis dri bzang po'i chu dang bcas pa'i rdo rje lag tu thogs nas gnas gsum du mas rim gyis gtug cing*/ snying gar hūm̐ sngon po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ spyi bor oṃ dkar po cig sgoms shig ces brjod do// yang rdo rje yas rim gyis gtug cing*/ hūm̐ de rdo rje sngon po hūm̐ gis mtshan pa/ āḥde pad+ma dmar po āḥs mtshan pa/ oṃ de 'khor lo dkar po oṃ gyis mtshan par sgoms shig ces bya ste/ phyag mtshan sa bon dang bcas pa de'i 'od zer gyi lcags kyus sku gsung thugs rdo rje bkug rang rang gi sa bon la bcug par sgoms shig

de la slob dpon gyi mchod pa lnga rol mo dang bcas pas mchod par bya'o// brgyad pa dngos grub kyi ltas brtag pa'i don du so shing sbyin pa ni mchod sbyin gyi shing lcang ma'am shug pa'am 'om bu la sogs pa 'bus ma zos shing ma yo ba dang gas pa dang chag pa'i skyon dang bral ba'i so shing sor bcu gnyis pa'i tshad dri'i chus brlan zhing me tog gi 'phreng bas brgyan pa oṃ āḥhūm̐ bzlas te slob ma'i thal mo sbyar ba'i bar du sbyin/ de nas slob dpon gyis 'di skad brjod par bya ste/ mi smra ba ni so shing bca'// bca' zhing de bzhin mi dgas shing*// phan tshun du yang mi 'dor ro// so shing mdun du drang por dor// zhes bshad pas kha shar phyogs su bltas la so shing gi rtsa ba cung zad 'jib pa'i tshul dang*/ de nas mgo mjug bsgyur la rtse mo 'jib pa'i tshul dang*/ de nas rtsa bas so drud pa'i tshul du gyis la rtse mo gyen du bstan pa maṇ+ḍal gyi dbus su dor zhig /de nas dngos grub kyi ltas brtag pa ni/ de yi tshe na mtshan ma ni// de tshe bdag la blta ba dang*// rtse mo gyen du bsgreng gyur na// de ni dngos grub mchog ces bshad// de bzhin shar du blta na ni/ de ni dngos grub 'bring du bshad// mtshams dang byang du kha bltas na// 'jig rten pa yi dngos grub 'thob// so shing 'dor ba rgya zhig la// gal te thur du kha bltas na// de ni nges par sa 'og gi// dngos grub de la the tshom med// ces pa'i tshul gyis brtag par bya'o// dgu pa khyor chu sbyin pa ni/ dri bzang po'i chu khyor bar lan gsum sngags 'dis 'thung du gzhug ste/ oṃ hrīḥbi shud+dha sarba dharmāḥsar+b+ba pā pa ni tsā s+ya bi sho dha ya sar+b+ba bi kalpan a pa nā ya hūm̐/ des rnam par rtog pa thams cad sbyang bar bya'o// bcu pa rmi lam gyi ltas brtag pa'i don du ku sha sbyin pa ni/ ku sha'i chun po dri chus bsangs la/

oṃ āḥhūm̐ bzlas pa'i nyung ba sngas dang mang ba stan gyi don du sbyin no// bcu gnyis pa bar chad bsrung ba'i don du srung skud gdags pa ni/ skud pa dmar po la rtsa ba'i sngags kyis btab pa'i srung skud mdud pa gsum dang ldan pa skyes pa'i dpung pa g.yon dang bud med kyi g.yas su gdags/ de la dri'i chus byug /bcu gnyis pa spro ba bskyed pa'i phyir zab rgyas kyi chos bshad pa ni/ 'jig rten khams ni ma lus par// thams cad mkhyen pa 'byung mi 'gyur// u dum wā ra'i me tog bzhin// brgya lam na ni res 'ga' zhig /'byung 'gyur yang ni mi 'byung srid// gsang sngags spyod pa'i tshul 'byung ba// de bas kyang ni dkon pa ste// gnyis med zab mo'i spyod tshul 'dis// sems can sangs rgyas byed pa yin// bskal pa grangs med mang por ni// sngon du byas pa'i rnam smin gang*// de kun zad par 'gyur ba ni// zab mo'i dkyil 'khor mthong bas so// zhes brjod/ nus na dge sbyor gyis/ mi nus na seng ge'i nyal stabs su dgyes pa rdo rje yid la gyis la nyol la rmi lam du gang rmis pa de nang par nga la smros shig ces brjod la gnas khang de nyid du nyal du gzhug go// de nas slob dpon yol ba'i nang du zhugs te dkyil 'khor gyi lha la mchod bstod/ dge ba bsngo ba/ 'dod don gsol ba rnams byas te yi ge brgya pa ci nus bzla/ mar me dang spos mtshan thub phul te ci bde bar nyal lo// nang par slob dpon gyis rmi lam ci rmis zhes dris/ des kyang ji ltar rmis pa smra'o// ltas brtag pa ni rmi lam sangs rgyas mthong ba na/ zhes sogs byung na bzang*/ mun nag btson rar tshud pa sogs byung na ngan pas de rnams bzlog pa'i thabs ni/ ba'i rnam lnga dang bsres pa'i btung ba la bdud rtsi 'khyil pa'i sngags btab pa 'thung du bcug pas kyang bzlog /bdud rtsi lnga'i chu 'thung du bcug pa dang*/

chos thams cad rmi lam ltar yid la byed du bcug pa dang*/ drag po'i sbyin sreg rnams kyis kyang bzlog go// gsum pa dkyil 'khor zhag gi cho ga la bzhi las/ dang po thig tshon gyi cho ga ni/ dkyil 'khor gyi lha/ sngar btegs med na badz+rod tiṣ+ṭha zhes pas nam mkhar bteg /de nas bskyed rim yan lag drug ldan bsgoms te/ dkyil 'khor bsdus la las kyi he ru kar gyur nas shes rab ma mtshan dang ldan pa 'am/ sgrub pa'i grogs mchog gis bkal ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi nyis 'gyur longs pa'i tshon sna lnga'i skud pa/ slob dpon rtogs pa dang ldan na oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis bde stong gi ngo bor byin gyis brlab/ rnam par rtog pa shas che na thod pa'i nang du bzhag /des shū n+ya tā sa bsangs/ stong pa'i ngang las skud pa sngon po hūm̐ las mi bskyod dgyes rdor/ dkar po bh+rum̐ las rnam snang dgyes rdor/ ser po dz+riṃ las rin 'byung dgyes rdor/ dmar po aṃ las snang mtha' dgyes rdor/ ljang khu khaṃ las don grub dgyes rdor rnams su bskyed/ thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros pas ye shes kyi rigs lnga spyan drangs/ gau rī dzaḥtsau rī hūm̐/ bai tā lī baṃ/ ghasmā rī hoḥ.oṃ dza hūm̐ sogs mchod yon sngon du 'gro ba'i nyer spyod lngas mchod/ zhe sdang rdo rje sogs kyis bstod/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis rigs lnga 'od du zhu nas thig tu gyur/

thig skud rnams grogs dang bcas te bsgril nas ye shes kyi thig gdab pa ni/ slob dpon shar na gnas pas dzaḥdzaḥ zhes thig gi sna grogs kyi lag tu gtad/ des kyang skud pa'i sna gzung la rgyab nas bskor te nub tu song la/ sa ma ya sū tra mā ti kra ma hūm̐ zhes brjod cing*/ thig skud kyi sgras 'jig rten gyi khams kyi bde bar gshegs pa thams cad la khyed kyi sems can gyi don mdzad pa'i dus yin no zhes bskul bar bsams la tshangs thig dang po gdab/ de bzhin du bskor te grogs lho dang slob dpon rgyab nas bskor te byang du gnas pas gnyis pa/ de nas grogs kyis rgyab nas bskor te dbang ldan dang*/ slob dpon gyis bskor te mer 'dug la shar gyi logs thig /slob mas bskor te bden bral dang*/ slob dpon gyis bskor te rlung du gnas pas nub kyi logs thig /slob dpon de nyid dang grogs kyis bskor te dbang ldan du gnas pas byang gi thig /slob dpon gyis rgyab nas bskor te me dang grogs kyis bskor te bden bral du gnas pas lho thig /slob dpon de nyid dang grogs rlung du gnas pas zur thig dang po/ slob dpon bden bral dang grogs dbang ldan du gnas pas zur thig gnyis pa rnams gdab cing chad pa dang ring thung phyogs 'khrul sogs nyes skyon dang bral bar bya/ de ltar thig chen brgyad gnam thig tu gdab bo// thig skud kyi ye shes pa gshegs/ las thig man ngag bzhin gdab/ tshon thig bzhin byin gyis brlab/ pra brtag pa ni 'khor lo'i dbus su 'dug ste kha phyir blta bas byang shar gyi mtshams su phyi mthar dkar po/ de nas ser dmar ljang nag po rnams 'khyig gang tsam g.yon pas 'then/ thod pa steng du bkab ste de'i steng du rdo rje bzhag la/ chos dbyings 'di ni dag pa ste// sems can khams ni rab grol ba// rgyal chen dgyes pa rdo rje yi// dkyil 'khor rab tu bri bar bya//

zhes brjod de me tog gcig gtor la/ thams cad mnyam zhing bar chad med// ngan pa dang ni nyams pa dang*// ma snyoms pa dang bar chad na// gnod pa mang po 'byung bar 'gyur// zhes pa ltar tshon pra brtag /de nas lte ba nas rim par man ngag bzhin bris nas thig skud dang tshon lhag ma'i ye shes pa gshegs par bya'o// de nas lag len bzhin bri/ gnyis pa dkyil 'khor gyi gnas nye bar brgyan pa ni/ mchod pa'i rdzas/ rnal 'byor gyi yo byad tshang bar bsags la lag len bzhin du nye bar brgyan par bya'o// gsum pa dkyil 'khor bsgrub pa la gsum las/ dang po mdun bskyed ni/ slob dpon bdag nyid khrus byas/ khar bdud rtsi ril bu bcug /rus pa'i rgyan cha lngas brgyan te/ dkyil 'khor gyi shar phyogs su stan nang tshangs can bting ba la rdo rje skyil krung gis 'dug ste/ 'byung gtor byin gyis brlab pa nas/ bdag dang gnas dang rnal 'byor bsrung ba'i bar dkyil chog gi gong du 'byung ba ltar bya/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhes brjod cing bdud rtsi'i bsangs gtor dkyil 'khor la byas pas/ thugs phyag mtshan rnams bkod pa la phog pas bdud rtsi'i thig ler gyur/ de las rdul tshon nam ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor thabs shes rab kyi ngang nas chos kyi 'byung gnas gru gsum pa rtsa ba phra ba thur du zug pa/ gdengs ka che ba/ kha dog dkar po/ de'i nang du sa'i dkyil 'khor gru bzhi/ de'i steng du chu'i dkyil 'khor zlum po/ de'i steng du me'i dkyil 'khor gru gsum/ de'i steng du rlung gi dkyil 'khor zla gam/ 'byung bzhi'i steng du bh+rūṃ las 'khor lo rtsibs sum cu rtsa gnyis pa/ 'khor lo de'i dbus su nā da cha gcig zhugs/ de rnams 'dres pa las rin po che sna lnga las grub pa'i gzhal yas khang mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa gru bzhi sgo bzhi rta babs bzhi dang ldan pa/ rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ shar dkar/

lho ser/ nub dmar/ byang ljang ba/ dbus su pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa lte ba nag po/ ze'u 'bru khra bo/ 'dab brgyad dmar po/ gong ras nag po/ thod 'phreng dkar po/ phyi rol tu dur khrod chen po brgyad kyis bskor ba bsgoms la/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a nī la badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ de'i dbus su nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du tshangs pa ser po dang dbang po dkar po gnyis mgo g.yas su blta ba/ nye dbang nag po dang drag po sngon po gnyis mgo g.yon du blta ba/ 'dab ma brgyad la shar nas phyogs dang byang shar nas mtshams g.yas skor du tshangs pa ser po/ dbang po dkar po/ nye dbang dmar po/ drag po sngon po/ gshin rje nag po/ nor bdag ser po/ srin po sngo nag /thags bzang ris ljang khu rnams mgo g.yon du blta ba/ gan rkyal du bsgyel ba/ kun gzhi dang ldan pa/ oṃ de wa pi tsu badz+ra hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ swā hā/ dbus kyi bdud bzhi'i gdan gyi steng du bcom ldan 'das dgyes pa rdo rje sku mdog nag po zhal brgyad zhabs bzhi phyag bcu drug pa rtsa ba'i zhal nag pa/ g.yas zhal dkar ba/ g.yon zhal dmar ba cher 'jigs pa/ lhag ma'i zhal gnyis gnyis nag pa/ steng zhal dud kha gtsigs pa/ zhal re re la spyan gsum gsum dang ldan zhing spyan rtsa dmar ba dbu skra ser po gyen du brdzes pa/ spyi bor sna tshogs rdo rjes mtshan pa/ phyag g.yas pa'i thod pa brgyad kyi dang po na glang po che dkar po/ gnyis pa na rta sngon po/ gsum pa na bong bu gwa pa/ bzhi pa na glang dmar po/ lnga pa na rnga mo thal kha/ drug pa na mi dmar po/ bdun pa na seng ge sngon po/ brgyad pa na byi la gwa pa rnams gdong nang du bstan te bsnams pa/ g.yon pa'i thod pa brgyad kyi dang po na sa'i lha mo ser mo/ gnyis pa na chu'i lha mo dkar mo/ gsum pa na rlung gi lha mo dud kha/ bzhi pa na me'i lha mo dmar mo/ lnga pa na zla ba'i lha mo dkar mo/ drug pa na nyi ma'i lha mo dmar mo/

bdun pa na gshin rje nag po/ brgyad pa na nor bdag ser po/ de thams cad kyang zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa thal mo snying kar sbyar ba zhal phyir bstan te bsnams pa/ phyag dang po gnyis kyis yum la 'khyud pa/ dbu re re la mi mgo skam po lnga lngas brgyan cing*/ rlon pa khrag 'dzag pa lnga bcu'i phreng bas do shal byas pa/ thal chen gyis lus la byugs pa/ gar gyi nyams dgu dang ldan pa/ zhabs bzhi'i g.yas pa gnyis brkyang zhing g.yon pa gnyis bskum pa'i gar stabs kyis bdud bzhi'i snying ga mnan pa/ de'i yum bdag med ma sku mdog nag mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma/ spyan gsum dmar ba/ dbu skra ser po gyen du brdzes pa g.yas gri gug /g.yon thod pa khrag gis gang ba bsnams nas yab kyi mgul nas 'khyud pa/ mi mgo skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan dang*/ rlon pa lnga bcu'i 'phreng bas do shal byas pa/ zhabs g.yas pa yab la 'khyud cing g.yon brkyang ba/ yab yum gnyis ka'i spyi bor rus pa'i 'khor lo/ rna rgyan mgul rgyan lag gdub ska rags te rus pa'i rgyan cha lngas brgyan pa/ mtshan dang dpe byad kyis spras pa/ me ri dang me dpung gi nang du bzhugs par gyur/ bcom ldan 'das kyi thugs kar ye shes sems dpa' rang 'dra ba tshon gang ba/ de'i thugs kar ting nge 'dzin sems dpa' rdo rje sngon po rtse dgu pa nas tsam pa'i lte ba la sran chung gshegs pa'i ga'u tsam pa'i nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor/ de'i dbus su hūm̐ sngon po spus bris pa tsam pa/ yum gyi thugs kar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du a sngon po 'od zer dang bcas pa/ oṃ gau rī gaṃ swā hā/ shar du gau rī ma nag mo g.yas gri gug g.yon ro hi ta'i nya bsnams pa/ oṃ tsau rī ma swā hā/ lhor tsau ri ma dmar mo g.yas cang te'u g.yon phag pa bsnams pa/ oṃ bai tā lī baṃ swā hā/ nub tu bai tā li ser mo g.yas ru sbal/ g.yon thod pa bsnams pa/ oṃ ghasma rī ghaṃ swā hā/

byang du ghasma rī ljang khu g.yas sbrul/ g.yon rnal 'byor gyi lhung bzed bsnams pa/ oṃ puk+ka sī paṃ swā hā/ puk+ka si sngon mo g.yas seng ge/ g.yon dgra s+t+wa bsnams pa/ oṃ sha wa rī shaṃ swā hā/ sha wa ri dkar mo g.yas dge slong*/ g.yon gsil byed bsnams pa/ oṃ tsaṇ+ḍā li tsaṃ swā hā/ tsaṇ+ḍā li sngon mo g.yas 'khor lo/ g.yon thod pa bsnams pa/ oṃ ḍom+bi nī ḍāṃ swā hā/ ḍom+bi nī zhal ras dkar ba/ thugs ka nag pa/ lte ba dmar ba/ mdongs mo dkar ba/ brla dang dpung pa ser ba/ lag ngar gnyis dang rkang pa'i rje ngar ljang khu/ g.yas rdo rje/ g.yon sdigs mdzub mdzad pa/ lha mo de thams cad zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma/ spyan gsum dmar ba/ dbu skra ser po gyen du brdzes pa/ rus pa'i rgyan cha lngas brgyan pa/ zhabs g.yon brkyang ba/ g.yas pa'i mthil g.yon pa'i brla la gtad de skyil krung phyed pa'i gar stabs kyis me ri dang me dpung gi nang na bzhugs par gyur/ gtso bo'i mig tu oṃ las gti mug rdo rje ma dkar mo/ rna bar haṃ las zhe sdang rdo rje ma nag mo/ sna la laṃ las ser sna rdo rje ma ser mo/ lce la raṃ las 'dod chags rdo rje ma dmar mo/ dpral bar aṃ las phrag dog rdo rje ma ljang khu/ snying gi cha stod du a las dbang phyug rdo rje ma sngon mo/ spyi bor oṃ las sku rdo rje ma dkar mo/ mgrin par āḥlas gsung rdo rje ma dmar mo/ snying gi cha smad du hūm̐ las thugs rdo rje ma sngon mo/ de thams cad kyang zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma/ g.yas na gri gug /g.yon thod pa/ mchan khung du kha ṭ+wāṃ ga bcug pa/ skyil krung phyed pa'i gar gyis ro'i gdan gyi steng na bzhugs pa'o// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta khe tsa ri badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta bhū tsa ri badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta pa tā la wā si nī badz+ra swā bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ nam mkhar gnas pa'i sta gon gyi lha tshogs rnams kyang gau rī dzaḥtsau rī hūm̐/

bai tā lī baṃ/ ghasma rī hoḥmadun bskyed dang gnyis su med par gyur/lha sta gon ma byas na sta gon gyi lha bstim pa 'di mi dgos/ zhes mdun bskyed bsgrub/ de nas ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor gzhug pa'i don du/ gnyis pa bdag bskyed ni/ he badz+ra/ rang nyid skad cig gis dgyes pa rdo rje sogs/ tshogs bsags nas brtsams/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhes pas/ lha mo brgyad zhal du bsdus te thim/ zhes pa'i bar mngon rtogs bzhin la gtso bo yab yum gyi ting nge 'dzin la gnas par bya'o// 'di'i dkyil chog dkyus su bzlas pa mi gsal yang*/ bla ma gong ma rnams kyis bzlas pa mdzad par snang ba ltar na/ yum gyi thugs kar zla dkyil gyi sogs nas gtso 'khor gyi bzlas pa rdzogs pa'i bar bya'o// gsum pa mngal 'byin ni/ rang nyid gtso bo yab yum gyi ting nge 'dzin la snyoms 'jug byas pas sid kyi sgras lha dgu'i ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor yang dag par bkug ste bdag nyid kyi kha'i lam du bcug nas/ rdo rje'i lam nas byung ste lha mo'i pad+mar phyung la/ de nas dkyil 'khor de nam mkha'i phyogs su 'thon te bzhugs par gyur/ hūm̐ gis bgegs bskrad/ oṃ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥkhaṃ raṃ āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ mchod yon/ oṃ ni ri ti hūm̐ khaṃ āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ zhabs bsil/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ de bzhin dhā pe= gan+dhe= nai wi d+ya= ā lo ke= lngas mchod/ oṃ gau rī gaṃ āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ de bzhin thog mtha' 'dra bas/ tsau rī tsaṃ= bai tā li baṃ= ghasma rī ghaṃ= puk+ka sī paṃ= sha wa ri shaṃ= tsaṇ+ḍā lī tsaṃ= ḍom+bi nī ḍāṃ= zhes lha mo brgyad kyi sngags 'ba' zhig gis phyi nang gsang ba de kho na nyid kyis mchod/ thugs rje thabs mkhas 'gro ba'i don mdzad phyir// chags pas 'dul mdzad bdag med ma la 'khyud// gdul bya'i dbang gis gar dgu'i rol pa mdzad// bcom ldan dgyes rdor sku la phyag 'tshal bstod// mgon po bde chen sku dang gnyis med yum// lha mo bdag med mkha' 'gro'i dbang phyug gtso// bha ga'i dbyings nas lha mo'i tshogs sprul ma// rdo rje bdag med ma la phyag 'tshal bstod// gzugs sogs phung po bzhi ni rnam dag cing*// ye shes rnam pa bzhi yi rang bzhin can// zhe sdang la sogs nyon mongs bzhi sbyong ba// gau rī ma sogs sgo ma bzhi la bstod// sa sogs 'byung ba bzhi ni rnam dag cing*// byams sogs tshad med bzhi yi rang bzhin can// mgon po bde chen thugs ni skul mdzad ma// puk+ka sī sogs mtshams ma rnams la bstod//
